  339:                         cash, replayProfile.minimumUsdtReserve(), replayDailyBudget,
  340:                         addPercent, open.positionPercent(), false, replayProfile.maximumDailyNewPositions(),
  341:                         replayExecutedNewPositions, fresh.price());
  342:                 BigDecimal budget = sizing.spend();
  343:                 if (sizing.allowed()) {
  344:                     addPercent = sizing.normalizedPositionPercent();
  345:                     BigDecimal addedQty = sizing.quantity();
  346:                     persistBuy(runId, symbol, signal, fresh, addedQty, budget, addPercent, decision);
  347:                     executionIntelligenceService.markExecuted(signal, decision);
  348:                     // FIX-112A: a progressive add consumes only its own triggering signal.
  349:                     replayScope.markEntryConsumed(signal.getId());
  350:                     cash = cash.subtract(budget, MC);
  351:                     open = addToPosition(runId, open, signal, addedQty, budget, addPercent);
  352:                 }
  353:             }
  354:         }
  355:         }
  356: 
  357:         BigDecimal finalWallet = cash;
  358:         if (open != null && !timeline.isEmpty()) {
  359:             BigDecimal mark = timeline.get(timeline.size() - 1).getLatestPrice();
  360:             if (mark != null) finalWallet = finalWallet.add(mark.multiply(open.quantity(), MC), MC);
  361:         }
  362: 
  363:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  364:                 UPDATE analysis_test_run
  365:                 SET simulated_trade_count=?, simulated_win_count=?, simulated_loss_count=?,
  366:                     simulated_realized_pnl=?, simulated_final_wallet=?
  367:                 WHERE id=?
  368:                 """, trades, wins, losses, realized, finalWallet, runId);
  369:         // FIX-109: expose whether this run had the persisted live-price stream required
  370:         // for tick-exact production ordering. Older windows remain explicitly labelled
  371:         // as fallback instead of being mistaken for exact parity.
  372:         return new ReplayStats(trades, wins, losses, realized, finalWallet,
  373:                 exactPriceReplay ? "EXACT_PRICE_REPLAY" : "SIGNAL_PRICE_FALLBACK",
  374:                 replayLogicMode);
  375:         } finally {
  376:             activeReplayProfile.remove();
  377:         }
  378:     }
  379: 
  380:     /**
  381:      * FIX-052: mechanical position protection evaluated from the exact Production
  382:      * 1m live-price observation stream. The order mirrors LivePositionProtectionService:
  383:      * TAKE_PROFIT -> STOP_LOSS -> PROFIT_LOCK -> normal HTF exit. The newly closed
  384:      * 1m signal is intentionally not visible yet; BinanceKlineService calls onPrice()
  385:      * before publishing the candle-close event in Production.
  386:      */
  387:     private LivePriceEvaluation evaluateLivePrice(long runId, String symbol, ShadowPosition p,
  388:                                                    MarketPriceEventService.PriceEvent event,
  389:                                                    TradeSignal oneMinute, TradeSignal five, TradeSignal one) {
  390:         BigDecimal price = event.price();
  391:         ShadowPosition current = p;
  392: 
  393:         if (current.takeProfit() != null && price.compareTo(current.takeProfit()) >= 0) {
  394:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(
  395:                     oneMinute, five, one,
  396:                     current.entryTrend(), current.entryStructure(), current.entryMomentum(), current.entryVolume(),
  397:                     current.entryConfidence(), current.entryScore());
  398:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
  399:                 BigDecimal distance = current.takeProfit().subtract(current.entryPrice());
  400:                 BigDecimal oldTarget = current.takeProfit();
  401:                 BigDecimal newTarget = oldTarget.add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
  402:                 ProfitLockState beforeState = current.profitLockState();
  403:                 current = rebaseForExtendedTarget(current, newTarget, price, event.observedAt()).withTakeProfit(newTarget);
  404:                 BigDecimal fix118NewProgress = progressPercent(current.entryPrice(), newTarget, current.highest());
  405:                 log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][TP_EXTENSION] runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, observedAt={}, marketPrice={}, " +
  406:                                 "entry={}, oldTp={}, newTp={}, highest={}, profitLockActive={}, profitLockPrice={}, previousState={}, state={}, " +
  407:                                 "newGeometryProgressPct={}",
  408:                         runId, current.positionId(), symbol, event.observedAt(), price, current.entryPrice(), oldTarget, newTarget,
  409:                         current.highest(), current.profitLockActive(), current.profitLockPrice(), beforeState, current.profitLockState(), fix118NewProgress);
  410:                 jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET take_profit_usdt=? WHERE id=?", newTarget, current.positionId());
  411:                 persistProfitLockState(current);
  412:                 persistNearTpState(current);
  413:                 persistManagementAtPrice(runId, symbol, event, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXTENDED", oldTarget, newTarget, current, continuation.explanation());
  414:                 return new LivePriceEvaluation(ExitDecision.hold(), current);
  415:             }
  416:             // FIX-11Q: baseline continuation has already failed. Only now may the replay-only
  417:             // counterfactual evaluate the one-candle grace. Existing PASS/TP-extension behavior above
  418:             // always wins first and is never intercepted by this experiment.
  419:             persistManagementAtPrice(runId, symbol, event, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXIT", current.takeProfit(), current.takeProfit(), current, continuation.explanation());
  420:             return new LivePriceEvaluation(new ExitDecision(true, "TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation()), current);
  421:         }
  422: 
  423:         // Production stop-loss has priority over profit-lock evaluation.
  424:         if (current.stopLoss() != null && price.compareTo(current.stopLoss()) <= 0) {
  425:             return new LivePriceEvaluation(new ExitDecision(true, "STOP_LOSS",
  426:                     "Live price " + price + " reached stop loss " + current.stopLoss()), current);
  427:         }
  428: 
  429:         ShadowPosition updated = profitLockState(current, price);
  430:         if (!equalsNullable(current.highest(), updated.highest())
  431:                 || current.profitLockActive() != updated.profitLockActive()
  432:                 || !equalsNullable(current.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice())
  433:                 || current.profitLockState() != updated.profitLockState()
  434:                 || !java.util.Objects.equals(current.profitLockRebaseStartedAt(), updated.profitLockRebaseStartedAt())) {
  435:             jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET highest_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_active=?, profit_lock_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_state=?, profit_lock_rebase_started_at=? WHERE id=?",
  436:                     updated.highest(), updated.profitLockActive(), updated.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockState().name(),
  437:                     updated.profitLockRebaseStartedAt() == null ? null : Timestamp.from(updated.profitLockRebaseStartedAt()), updated.positionId());
  438:         }
  439:         if (updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE
  440:                 || updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  441:                 || !equalsNullable(current.highest(), updated.highest())
  442:                 || current.profitLockActive() != updated.profitLockActive()
  443:                 || !equalsNullable(current.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice())
  444:                 || current.profitLockState() != updated.profitLockState()) {
  445:             BigDecimal fix118Progress = updated.takeProfit() == null || updated.takeProfit().compareTo(updated.entryPrice()) <= 0
  446:                     ? BigDecimal.ZERO
  447:                     : updated.highest().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC)
  448:                             .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
  449:                             .divide(updated.takeProfit().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  450:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][LIVE_PATH] runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, observedAt={}, price={}, entry={}, target={}, " +
  451:                             "highest={}, previousActive={}, active={}, previousState={}, state={}, previousLock={}, lock={}, progressPct={}, triggered={}",
  452:                     runId, updated.positionId(), symbol, event.observedAt(), price, updated.entryPrice(), updated.takeProfit(),
  453:                     updated.highest(), current.profitLockActive(), updated.profitLockActive(), current.profitLockState(), updated.profitLockState(),
  454:                     current.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice(), fix118Progress,
  455:                     updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
  456:                             && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0);
  457:         }
  458:         current = updated;
  459: 
  460:         BigDecimal rebaseHardFloor = current.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005), MC);
  461:         if (current.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  462:                 && price.compareTo(rebaseHardFloor) < 0) {
  463:             String reason = "TP-extension rebase safety floor was breached at " + rebaseHardFloor + ". " + profitLockConfigText();
  464:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][REBASE_HARD_FLOOR] runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, observedAt={}, price={}, floor={}, target={}",
  465:                     runId, current.positionId(), symbol, event.observedAt(), price, rebaseHardFloor, current.takeProfit());
  466:             persistManagementAtPrice(runId, symbol, event, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", current.takeProfit(), current.takeProfit(), current, reason);
  467:             return new LivePriceEvaluation(new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", reason), current);
  468:         }
  469: 
  470:         if (current.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && current.profitLockPrice() != null
  471:                 && price.compareTo(current.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
  472:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][LIVE_TRIGGER] runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, observedAt={}, price={}, lock={}, target={}",
  473:                     runId, current.positionId(), symbol, event.observedAt(), price, current.profitLockPrice(), current.takeProfit());
  474:             BigDecimal hardProfitFloor = current.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005), MC);
  475:             if (price.compareTo(hardProfitFloor) < 0) {
  476:                 String reason = "Profit-lock hard floor was breached; protected profit can no longer be preserved. "
  477:                         + profitLockConfigText();
  478:                 persistManagementAtPrice(runId, symbol, event, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", current.takeProfit(), current.takeProfit(), current, reason);
  479:                 return new LivePriceEvaluation(new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", reason), current);
  480:             }
  481:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lockDecision = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(oneMinute, five, one);
  482:             if (lockDecision.exit()) {
  483:                 String reason = "Price retraced to the protected profit level after a profitable advance. "
  484:                         + lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
  485:                 persistManagementAtPrice(runId, symbol, event, "PROFIT_LOCK_EXIT", current.takeProfit(), current.takeProfit(), current, reason);
  486:                 return new LivePriceEvaluation(new ExitDecision(true, lockDecision.code(), reason), current);
  487:             }
  488:             persistManagementAtPrice(runId, symbol, event, "PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD", current.takeProfit(), current.takeProfit(), current,
  489:                     lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText());
  490:         }
  491: 
  492:         PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation normalExit = exitPolicy.evaluateNormalExit(oneMinute, five, one);
  493:         if (normalExit.exit()) {
  494:             return new LivePriceEvaluation(new ExitDecision(true, normalExit.code(), normalExit.explanation()), current);
  495:         }
  496: 
  497:         // FIX-11T: shared Production/Replay rule, evaluated LAST after all existing exits.
  498:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State nearTpState = new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
  499:                 current.nearTpState(), current.nearTpBestPrice(), current.nearTpBearishStreak(),
  500:                 current.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), current.nearTpHarvestUsed());
  501:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.Evaluation nearTp = nearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.evaluate(
  502:                 nearTpState, current.entryPrice(), current.takeProfit(), price, event.observedAt(), oneMinute, five);
  503:         ShadowPosition nearTpUpdated = current.withNearTp(nearTp.state());
  504:         if (!nearTpUpdated.sameNearTp(current)) {
  505:             persistNearTpState(nearTpUpdated);
  506:         }
  507:         current = nearTpUpdated;
  508:         if (nearTp.transition()) {
  509:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay Near-TP: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, code={}, state={}, price={}, best={}, givebackPct={}, bearish1mStreak={}, detail={}",
  510:                     runId, current.positionId(), symbol, nearTp.code(), current.nearTpState(), price,
  511:                     current.nearTpBestPrice(), nearTp.givebackPercent(), current.nearTpBearishStreak(), nearTp.explanation());
  512:         }
  513:         if (nearTp.harvestEligible()) {
  514:             BigDecimal soldQty = current.quantity().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC);
  515:             ReplayMinimumExecutionPolicy.Evaluation minimumCheck =
  516:                     replayMinimumExecutionPolicy.evaluate(profile().minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt(), soldQty, price);
  517:             if (!minimumCheck.executable()) {
  518:                 // Same as Production: a below-minimum Binance order is not simulated. Reset
  519:                 // to rejection monitoring and let all existing management continue unchanged.
  520:                 current = current.withNearTp(new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
  521:                         NearTpState.NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED, current.nearTpBestPrice(),
  522:                         0, current.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), false));
  523:                 persistNearTpState(current);
  524:                 log.info("FIX-11T Replay NEAR_TP_HARVEST_SKIPPED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, reason={}, requestedQty={}, requestedNotional={}, binanceMinimum={}; existing position management continues",
  525:                         runId, current.positionId(), symbol, minimumCheck.code(), soldQty,
  526:                         minimumCheck.requestedNotional(), minimumCheck.minimumNotional());
  527:                 return new LivePriceEvaluation(ExitDecision.hold(), current);
  528:             }
  529:             BigDecimal proceeds = soldQty.multiply(price, MC);
  530:             BigDecimal soldCost = current.entryPrice().multiply(soldQty, MC);
  531:             BigDecimal partialPnl = proceeds.subtract(soldCost, MC);
  532:             BigDecimal partialPct = soldCost.signum() == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO : partialPnl
  533:                     .divide(soldCost, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
  534:             current = current.withPartialHarvest(soldQty, soldCost, partialPnl);
  535:             persistNearTpPartialHarvest(runId, symbol, event, oneMinute, current, soldQty, proceeds, partialPnl, partialPct, nearTp.explanation());
  536:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, soldQty={}, remainingQty={}, price={}, partialPnl={}",
  537:                     runId, current.positionId(), symbol, soldQty, current.quantity(), price, partialPnl);
  538:             return new LivePriceEvaluation(ExitDecision.hold(), current, proceeds, partialPnl);
  539:         }
  540:         return new LivePriceEvaluation(ExitDecision.hold(), current);
  541:     }
  542: 
  543:     private ExitDecision evaluateExit(long runId, ShadowPosition p, TradeSignal s, TradeSignal oneMinute, TradeSignal five, TradeSignal one) {
  544:         BigDecimal price = s.getLatestPrice();
  545:         if (price == null) return ExitDecision.hold();
  546: 
  547:         // Replay uses the exact same temporal price-authority rule as production. A signal
  548:         // generated later may still carry a candle close from before entry; that historical
  549:         // price may update MTF context but may not retroactively hit TP/SL/profit-lock.
  550:         boolean authoritativePrice = priceAuthorityPolicy.canUseSignalPrice(s, p.entryTime());
  551:         if (authoritativePrice && p.takeProfit() != null && price.compareTo(p.takeProfit()) >= 0) {
  552:             // Exact production TP-continuation call, including immutable entry structure.
  553:             // FIX-011 regression relies on Replay and live using this same shared policy.
  554:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(
  555:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one,
  556:                     p.entryTrend(), p.entryStructure(), p.entryMomentum(), p.entryVolume(),
  557:                     p.entryConfidence(), p.entryScore());
  558:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
  559:                 BigDecimal distance = p.takeProfit().subtract(p.entryPrice());
  560:                 BigDecimal newTarget = p.takeProfit().add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
  561:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXTENDED", p.takeProfit(), newTarget, p, continuation.explanation());
  562:                 jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET take_profit_usdt=? WHERE id=?", newTarget, p.positionId());
  563:                 return new ExitDecision(false, "EXTEND_TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation(), newTarget);
  564:             }
  565:             persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), p, continuation.explanation());
  566:             return new ExitDecision(true, "TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation());
  567:         }
  568:         // FIX-052 fallback ordering also mirrors Production: STOP_LOSS is absolute and
  569:         // is evaluated before profit-lock. Exact V64 runs normally take this path from
  570:         // persisted live-price events rather than from signal-carried prices.
  571:         if (authoritativePrice && p.stopLoss() != null && price.compareTo(p.stopLoss()) <= 0)
  572:             return new ExitDecision(true, "STOP_LOSS", "Price reached the stored stop loss.");
  573: 
  574:         ShadowPosition updated = authoritativePrice ? profitLockState(p, price) : p;
  575:         if (authoritativePrice && (updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE
  576:                 || updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  577:                 || p.profitLockActive() != updated.profitLockActive()
  578:                 || !equalsNullable(p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice())
  579:                 || p.profitLockState() != updated.profitLockState())) {
  580:             BigDecimal fix118Progress = updated.takeProfit() == null || updated.takeProfit().compareTo(updated.entryPrice()) <= 0
  581:                     ? BigDecimal.ZERO
  582:                     : updated.highest().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC)
  583:                             .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
  584:                             .divide(updated.takeProfit().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  585:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_PATH] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, " +
  586:                             "entry={}, target={}, highest={}, previousActive={}, active={}, previousState={}, state={}, previousLock={}, lock={}, progressPct={}, triggered={}",
  587:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
  588:                     updated.entryPrice(), updated.takeProfit(), updated.highest(), p.profitLockActive(), updated.profitLockActive(),
  589:                     p.profitLockState(), updated.profitLockState(), p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice(), fix118Progress,
  590:                     updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
  591:                             && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0);
  592:         }
  593:         BigDecimal minimumProfitableExit = p.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005));
  594:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  595:                 && price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
  596:             String floorReason = "TP-extension rebase safety floor was breached at " + minimumProfitableExit + ". "
  597:                     + profitLockConfigText();
  598:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_REBASE_HARD_FLOOR] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, floor={}",
  599:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price, minimumProfitableExit);
  600:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
  601:             return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
  602:         }
  603:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
  604:                 && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
  605:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_TRIGGER] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, lock={}, target={}",
  606:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
  607:                     updated.profitLockPrice(), updated.takeProfit());
  608:             if (price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
  609:                 String floorReason = "Profit-lock hard floor was breached; protected profit can no longer be preserved. "
  610:                         + profitLockConfigText();
  611:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
  612:                 return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
  613:             }
  614:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lockDecision = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(
  615:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
  616:             if (!lockDecision.exit()) {
  617:                 String holdReason = lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
  618:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, holdReason);
  619:                 return ExitDecision.hold();
  620:             }
  621:             String lockReason = "Price retraced to the protected profit level after a profitable advance. "
  622:                     + lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
  623:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, lockReason);
  624:             return new ExitDecision(true, lockDecision.code(), lockReason);
  625:         }
  626:         // Production has two SELL authorities: the live HTF PositionExitPolicy and the
  627:         // 1m signal TradeExecutionValidationService. Replay executes both shared production
  628:         // policies in the same order instead of carrying a test-only SELL rule.
  629:         PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation normalExit = exitPolicy.evaluateNormalExit(
  630:                 oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
  631:         if (normalExit.exit()) {
  632:             return new ExitDecision(true, normalExit.code(), normalExit.explanation());
  633:         }
  634:         if ("1m".equals(s.getInterval()) && bearish(s.getDecision())) {
  635:             ReplaySellValidationPolicy.Result validatedSell = replaySellValidationPolicy.validate(s, five, one);
  636:             if (validatedSell.allowed()) {
  637:                 return new ExitDecision(true, validatedSell.code(), validatedSell.explanation());
  638:             }
  639:         }
  640:         return ExitDecision.hold();
  641:     }
  642: 
  643:     private FallbackNearTpEvaluation evaluateNearTpAtSignalFallback(long runId, ShadowPosition current,
  644:                                                                     TradeSignal signal, TradeSignal oneMinute,
  645:                                                                     TradeSignal fiveMinute) {
  646:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State state = new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
  647:                 current.nearTpState(), current.nearTpBestPrice(), current.nearTpBearishStreak(),
  648:                 current.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), current.nearTpHarvestUsed());
  649:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.Evaluation evaluation = nearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.evaluate(
  650:                 state, current.entryPrice(), current.takeProfit(), signal.getLatestPrice(), signal.getGeneratedAt(),
  651:                 oneMinute, fiveMinute);
  652:         ShadowPosition updated = current.withNearTp(evaluation.state());
  653:         if (!updated.sameNearTp(current)) persistNearTpState(updated);
  654:         if (evaluation.transition()) {
  655:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback Near-TP: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, code={}, state={}, price={}, givebackPct={}, bearish1mStreak={}, detail={}",
  656:                     runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), evaluation.code(), updated.nearTpState(),
  657:                     signal.getLatestPrice(), evaluation.givebackPercent(), updated.nearTpBearishStreak(), evaluation.explanation());
  658:         }
  659:         if (!evaluation.harvestEligible()) return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.ZERO);
  660: 
  661:         BigDecimal soldQty = updated.quantity().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC);
  662:             ReplayMinimumExecutionPolicy.Evaluation minimumCheck =
  663:                     replayMinimumExecutionPolicy.evaluate(profile().minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt(), soldQty, signal.getLatestPrice());
  664:         if (!minimumCheck.executable()) {
  665:             updated = updated.withNearTp(new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
  666:                     NearTpState.NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED, updated.nearTpBestPrice(),
  667:                     0, updated.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), false));
  668:             persistNearTpState(updated);
  669:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback NEAR_TP_HARVEST_SKIPPED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, reason={}, requestedQty={}, requestedNotional={}, binanceMinimum={}; existing position management continues",
  670:                     runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), minimumCheck.code(), soldQty,
  671:                     minimumCheck.requestedNotional(), minimumCheck.minimumNotional());
  672:             return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.ZERO);
  673:         }
  674:         BigDecimal proceeds = soldQty.multiply(signal.getLatestPrice(), MC);
  675:         BigDecimal soldCost = updated.entryPrice().multiply(soldQty, MC);
  676:         BigDecimal pnl = proceeds.subtract(soldCost, MC);
  677:         BigDecimal pnlPct = soldCost.signum() == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO : pnl.divide(soldCost, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
  678:                 .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
  679:         updated = updated.withPartialHarvest(soldQty, soldCost, pnl);
  680:         persistNearTpPartialHarvestAtSignal(runId, signal, updated, soldQty, proceeds, pnl, pnlPct, evaluation.explanation());
  681:         log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, soldQty={}, remainingQty={}, price={}, partialPnl={}",
  682:                 runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), soldQty, updated.quantity(), signal.getLatestPrice(), pnl);
  683:         return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, proceeds, pnl);
  684:     }
  685: 
  686:     private ShadowPosition updateProfitLock(ShadowPosition p, TradeSignal s) {
  687:         if (s.getLatestPrice() == null || !priceAuthorityPolicy.canUseSignalPrice(s, p.entryTime())) return p;
  688:         ShadowPosition n = profitLockState(p, s.getLatestPrice());
  689:         if (!equalsNullable(p.highest(), n.highest()) || p.profitLockActive() != n.profitLockActive()
  690:                 || !equalsNullable(p.profitLockPrice(), n.profitLockPrice())
  691:                 || p.profitLockState() != n.profitLockState()
  692:                 || !java.util.Objects.equals(p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt(), n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt())) {
  693:             jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET highest_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_active=?, profit_lock_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_state=?, profit_lock_rebase_started_at=? WHERE id=?",
  694:                     n.highest(), n.profitLockActive(), n.profitLockPrice(), n.profitLockState().name(),
  695:                     n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt() == null ? null : Timestamp.from(n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt()), p.positionId());
  696:         }
  697:         return n;
  698:     }
  699: 
  700:     private ShadowPosition profitLockState(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal price) {
  701:         ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();
  702:         BigDecimal activation = settings.profitLockActivationPercent();
  703:         BigDecimal highest = p.highest() == null ? price : p.highest().max(price);
  704:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), highest);
  705: 
  706:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  707:                 && progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
  708:             // Replay parity with Production FIX-118: preserve the historical lock/legacy flag,
  709:             // but keep it non-executable until the new TP geometry earns activation again.
  710:             return p.withLock(highest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
  711:                     p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
  712:         }
  713: 
  714:         // FIX-118 parity: when REBASE earns activation, rebuild the lock from the current
  715:         // TP geometry instead of retaining the superseded pre-extension lock.
  716:         boolean freshGeometryActivation = p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE;
  717:         ProfitLockPolicy.State state = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(
  718:                 p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), price, highest,
  719:                 freshGeometryActivation ? false : (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE || p.profitLockActive()),
  720:                 freshGeometryActivation ? null : p.profitLockPrice(),
  721:                 settings.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), activation,
  722:                 settings.profitLockInitialPercent(), settings.profitLockTrailStepPercent());
  723:         ProfitLockState nextState = state.active() ? ProfitLockState.ACTIVE : ProfitLockState.INACTIVE;
  724:         return p.withLock(state.highestPrice(), state.active(), state.lockPrice(), nextState, null);
  725:     }
  726: 
  727:     private ShadowPosition rebaseForExtendedTarget(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal newTarget, BigDecimal extensionPrice, Instant at) {
  728:         if (p == null || newTarget == null) return p;
  729:         BigDecimal oldTarget = p.takeProfit();
  730:         BigDecimal oldLock = p.profitLockPrice();
  731:         BigDecimal activation = profile().profitLockActivationPercent();
  732:         BigDecimal extensionHighest = p.highest() == null ? p.entryPrice() : p.highest();
  733:         if (extensionPrice != null && extensionPrice.compareTo(extensionHighest) > 0) extensionHighest = extensionPrice;
  734:         ShadowPosition withExtensionHigh = p.withLock(extensionHighest, p.profitLockActive(), p.profitLockPrice(),
  735:                 p.profitLockState(), p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
  736:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), newTarget, extensionHighest);
  737:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE) {
  738:             if (progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
  739:                 ShadowPosition rebasing = withExtensionHigh.withLock(extensionHighest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
  740:                         at == null ? Instant.now() : at);
  741:                 log.info("[FIX-120][REPLAY][TP_GEOMETRY_REBASE] positionId={}, previousState={}, newState={}, oldTarget={}, newTarget={}, " +
  742:                                 "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",
  743:                         p.positionId(), p.profitLockState(), rebasing.profitLockState(), oldTarget, newTarget, extensionPrice,
  744:                         extensionHighest, progress, oldLock, rebasing.profitLockPrice(), activation);
  745:                 return rebasing;
  746:             }
  747:             // FIX-120 Production/Replay parity: the old executable lock belongs to the
  748:             // superseded TP geometry. If the extended winner still qualifies, establish a
  749:             // fresh geometry baseline. Raw extensionPrice is current; extensionHighest is the
  750:             // historical-best seed; previousActive/previousLock are deliberately discarded.
  751:             ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();
  752:             BigDecimal currentForPolicy = extensionPrice == null ? extensionHighest : extensionPrice;
  753:             ProfitLockPolicy.State rebased = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(
  754:                     p.entryPrice(), newTarget, currentForPolicy, extensionHighest,
  755:                     false, null, settings.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), activation,
  756:                     settings.profitLockInitialPercent(), settings.profitLockTrailStepPercent());
  757:             if (rebased.active()) {
  758:                 ShadowPosition active = withExtensionHigh.withLock(rebased.highestPrice(), true, rebased.lockPrice(), ProfitLockState.ACTIVE, null);
  759:                 log.info("[FIX-120][REPLAY][TP_GEOMETRY_REBASE] positionId={}, previousState={}, newState={}, oldTarget={}, newTarget={}, " +
  760:                                 "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",
  761:                         p.positionId(), p.profitLockState(), active.profitLockState(), oldTarget, newTarget, extensionPrice,
  762:                         rebased.highestPrice(), rebased.progressPercent(), oldLock, rebased.lockPrice(), activation);
  763:                 return active;
  764:             }
  765:             ShadowPosition rebasing = withExtensionHigh.withLock(rebased.highestPrice(), true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
  766:                     at == null ? Instant.now() : at);
  767:             log.info("[FIX-120][REPLAY][TP_GEOMETRY_REBASE] positionId={}, previousState={}, newState={}, oldTarget={}, newTarget={}, " +
  768:                             "extensionPrice={}, highest={}, newGeometryProgressPct={}, oldLock={}, freshLock={}, activationPct={}, geometryRebased=true",
  769:                     p.positionId(), p.profitLockState(), rebasing.profitLockState(), oldTarget, newTarget, extensionPrice,
  770:                     rebased.highestPrice(), rebased.progressPercent(), oldLock, rebasing.profitLockPrice(), activation);
  771:             return rebasing;
  772:         }
  773:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE) {
  774:             return withExtensionHigh.withLock(extensionHighest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
  775:                     p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
  776:         }
  777:         return withExtensionHigh;
  778:     }
  779: 
  780:     private BigDecimal progressPercent(BigDecimal entry, BigDecimal target, BigDecimal highest) {
  781:         if (entry == null || target == null || highest == null || target.compareTo(entry) <= 0) return BigDecimal.ZERO;
  782:         BigDecimal favorable = highest.subtract(entry);
  783:         if (favorable.signum() < 0) favorable = BigDecimal.ZERO;
  784:         return favorable.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
  785:                 .divide(target.subtract(entry, MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  786:     }

  821:     private ShadowPosition addToPosition(long runId, ShadowPosition open, TradeSignal signal,
  822:                                          BigDecimal addedQty, BigDecimal addedCost, int addPercent) {
  823:         BigDecimal newQuantity = open.quantity().add(addedQty, MC);
  824:         BigDecimal newCost = open.cost().add(addedCost, MC);
  825:         BigDecimal newEntry = newCost.divide(newQuantity, 12, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  826:         BigDecimal newStop = open.stopLoss();
  827:         if (signal.getStopLoss() != null && (newStop == null || signal.getStopLoss().compareTo(newStop) > 0)) {
  828:             newStop = signal.getStopLoss();
  829:         }
  830:         BigDecimal newTakeProfit = open.takeProfit();
  831:         if (signal.getTakeProfit() != null && (newTakeProfit == null || signal.getTakeProfit().compareTo(newTakeProfit) > 0)) {
  832:             newTakeProfit = signal.getTakeProfit();
  833:         }
  834:         int newPercent = Math.min(100, open.positionPercent() + addPercent);
  835:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  836:                 UPDATE wallet_position_test
  837:                 SET entry_price=?, quantity=?, total_cost_usdt=?, position_percent=?,
  838:                     stop_loss_usdt=?, take_profit_usdt=?
  839:                 WHERE id=? AND test_run_id=?
  840:                 """, newEntry, newQuantity, newCost, newPercent, newStop, newTakeProfit,
  841:                 open.positionId(), runId);
  842:         ShadowPosition updated = open.withAdd(newEntry, newQuantity, newCost, newPercent, newStop, newTakeProfit);
  843:         persistNearTpState(updated);
  844:         return updated;
  845:     }

  989:     private BigDecimal totalPositionPnlPercent(ShadowPosition position, BigDecimal remainingLegPnl) {
  990:         BigDecimal totalPnl = position.partialRealizedPnl().add(remainingLegPnl, MC);
  991:         BigDecimal totalInvestedCost = position.cost().add(position.partialHarvestCostBasis(), MC);
  992:         return totalInvestedCost.signum() == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO
  993:                 : totalPnl.divide(totalInvestedCost, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
  994:     }

  996:     private BigDecimal percentage(BigDecimal entry,BigDecimal exit){return exit.subtract(entry).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100)).divide(entry,8,RoundingMode.HALF_UP);}
  997:     private boolean bullish(SignalDecision d){return d==SignalDecision.BUY||d==SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY;}
  998:     private boolean bearish(SignalDecision d){return d==SignalDecision.SELL||d==SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL;}
  999:     private String name(SignalDecision d){return d==null?null:d.name();}
 1000:     private int intervalOrder(String i){return "1h".equals(i)?0:"5m".equals(i)?1:2;}
 1001:     private boolean equalsNullable(BigDecimal a,BigDecimal b){return a==null?b==null:b!=null&&a.compareTo(b)==0;}

 1017:     private record ShadowPosition(long positionId, Instant entryTime, BigDecimal entryPrice, BigDecimal quantity,
 1018:                                   BigDecimal cost, int positionPercent, BigDecimal stopLoss, BigDecimal takeProfit,
 1019:                                   BigDecimal highest, boolean profitLockActive, BigDecimal profitLockPrice,

 1021:                                   int entryScore, int entryConfidence, int entryTrend, int entryStructure,

 1023:                                   int nearTpBearishStreak, Long nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId, boolean nearTpHarvestUsed,
 1024:                                   BigDecimal nearTpHarvestedQuantity, BigDecimal partialRealizedPnl,
 1025:                                   BigDecimal partialHarvestCostBasis) {
 1026:         ShadowPosition withLock(BigDecimal h, boolean a, BigDecimal l, ProfitLockState state, Instant rebaseStartedAt) {
 1027:             return new ShadowPosition(positionId, entryTime, entryPrice, quantity, cost, positionPercent, stopLoss, takeProfit,
 1028:                     h, a, l, state, rebaseStartedAt,
 1029:                     entryScore, entryConfidence, entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
 1030:                     nearTpState, nearTpBestPrice, nearTpBearishStreak, nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId, nearTpHarvestUsed,
 1031:                     nearTpHarvestedQuantity, partialRealizedPnl, partialHarvestCostBasis);
 1032:         }
 1033:         ShadowPosition withTakeProfit(BigDecimal tp) {
 1034:             // FIX-117 Replay parity: TP extension preserves already-earned Near-TP protection
 1035:             // exactly like Production. REJECTION_DETECTED keeps its state/best price but clears
 1036:             // bearish persistence accumulated under the old geometry. INACTIVE and
 1037:             // FAILURE_CONFIRMED keep the pre-FIX-117 reset behavior. Harvested state is terminal.
 1038:             NearTpState state = nearTpState;
 1039:             BigDecimal bestPrice = nearTpBestPrice;
 1040:             int bearishStreak = nearTpBearishStreak;
 1041:             Long lastOneMinuteSignalId = nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId;
 1042: 
 1043:             if (!nearTpHarvestUsed) {
 1044:                 switch (nearTpState) {
 1045:                     case INACTIVE, NEAR_TP_FAILURE_CONFIRMED -> {
 1046:                         state = NearTpState.INACTIVE;
 1047:                         bestPrice = null;
 1048:                         bearishStreak = 0;
 1049:                         lastOneMinuteSignalId = null;
 1050:                     }
 1051:                     case NEAR_TP_ARMED -> { }
 1052:                     case NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED -> {
 1053:                         bearishStreak = 0;
 1054:                         lastOneMinuteSignalId = null;
 1055:                     }
 1056:                     case NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED -> { }
 1057:                 }
 1058:             }
 1059: 
 1060:             return new ShadowPosition(positionId, entryTime, entryPrice, quantity, cost, positionPercent, stopLoss, tp,
 1061:                     highest, profitLockActive, profitLockPrice, profitLockState, profitLockRebaseStartedAt,
 1062:                     entryScore, entryConfidence, entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
 1063:                     state, bestPrice, bearishStreak, lastOneMinuteSignalId, nearTpHarvestUsed,
 1064:                     nearTpHarvestedQuantity, partialRealizedPnl, partialHarvestCostBasis);
 1065:         }
 1066:         ShadowPosition withAdd(BigDecimal newEntry, BigDecimal newQuantity, BigDecimal newCost, int newPercent, BigDecimal newStop, BigDecimal newTakeProfit) {
 1067:             NearTpState state = nearTpHarvestUsed ? nearTpState : NearTpState.INACTIVE;
 1068:             return new ShadowPosition(positionId, entryTime, newEntry, newQuantity, newCost, newPercent, newStop, newTakeProfit,
 1069:                     highest, profitLockActive, profitLockPrice, profitLockState, profitLockRebaseStartedAt,
 1070:                     entryScore, entryConfidence, entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
 1071:                     state, nearTpHarvestUsed ? nearTpBestPrice : null, nearTpHarvestUsed ? nearTpBearishStreak : 0,
 1072:                     nearTpHarvestUsed ? nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId : null, nearTpHarvestUsed, nearTpHarvestedQuantity,
 1073:                     partialRealizedPnl, partialHarvestCostBasis);
 1074:         }
 1075:         ShadowPosition withNearTp(NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State state) {
 1076:             return new ShadowPosition(positionId, entryTime, entryPrice, quantity, cost, positionPercent, stopLoss, takeProfit,
 1077:                     highest, profitLockActive, profitLockPrice, profitLockState, profitLockRebaseStartedAt,
 1078:                     entryScore, entryConfidence, entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
 1079:                     state.nearTpState(), state.bestPrice(), state.consecutiveBearishOneMinute(), state.lastEvaluatedOneMinuteSignalId(),
 1080:                     state.harvestUsed(), nearTpHarvestedQuantity, partialRealizedPnl, partialHarvestCostBasis);
 1081:         }
 1082:         ShadowPosition withPartialHarvest(BigDecimal soldQty, BigDecimal soldCost, BigDecimal realizedPnl) {
 1083:             return new ShadowPosition(positionId, entryTime, entryPrice, quantity.subtract(soldQty, MC), cost.subtract(soldCost, MC),
 1084:                     positionPercent, stopLoss, takeProfit, highest, profitLockActive, profitLockPrice,
 1085:                     profitLockState, profitLockRebaseStartedAt,
 1086:                     entryScore, entryConfidence, entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
 1087:                     NearTpState.NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED, nearTpBestPrice, nearTpBearishStreak, nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId, true,
 1088:                     nearTpHarvestedQuantity.add(soldQty, MC), partialRealizedPnl.add(realizedPnl, MC),
 1089:                     partialHarvestCostBasis.add(soldCost, MC));
 1090:         }
 1091:         boolean sameNearTp(ShadowPosition other) {
 1092:             return nearTpState == other.nearTpState
 1093:                     && equalsDecimal(nearTpBestPrice, other.nearTpBestPrice)
 1094:                     && nearTpBearishStreak == other.nearTpBearishStreak
 1095:                     && java.util.Objects.equals(nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId, other.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId)
 1096:                     && nearTpHarvestUsed == other.nearTpHarvestUsed;
 1097:         }
 1098:         private boolean equalsDecimal(BigDecimal a, BigDecimal b) {
 1099:             return a == null ? b == null : b != null && a.compareTo(b) == 0;
 1100:         }
 1101:     }
 1102: 
 1103: }

  323:             boolean passed = cadencePass && authorityPass && generationPass && livePriceParityPass;
  324: 
  325:             String notes = "Fresh replay signals are generated from historical candles through TechnicalIndicatorService "
  326:                     + "and the production AnalysisService scoring/final-decision path without trade_signal persistence. "
  327:                     + "A three-hour context-only warm-up seeds 1m/5m/1h state before the requested execution window, and BTC reference signals are freshly replayed as-of each timestamp when BTC context is enabled. "
  328:                     + "Historical signal counts are retained only as the pre-fix reference. "
  329:                     + (historicalEventCoveragePass
  330:                         ? "Historical event-resolution coverage is complete for the requested 1m/5m/1h candles. "
  331:                         : "FIX-11O source-data warning: historical event-resolution coverage is incomplete (1m "
  332:                             + replay1m + "/" + requestedCandles1m + ", 5m " + replay5m + "/" + requestedCandles5m
  333:                             + ", 1h " + replay1h + "/" + requestedCandles1h + "). Fresh Replay cadence is evaluated "
  334:                             + "from generated signals instead, so an old Production persistence/closed-marker gap remains visible without hiding valid Replay BUY/SELL output. ")
  335:                     + (livePriceParityPass
  336:                         ? "FIX-052/FIX-056 exact price parity is active: Replay consumed " + productionPriceEvents.size() + " persisted Production 1m live-price observations in UTC order, exposes the latest event through the shared ExecutionPriceAuthorityService, and revalidates/sizes BUYs from that execution-time price. "
  337:                         : "FIX-052/FIX-056 exact price parity is NOT available for this historical window because no persisted Production live-price observations exist; the run is intentionally not marked fully passed. ")
  338:                     + "FIX-153 persisted price outcomes in consumed window (NON_CANONICAL/PROTECTION_NOT_APPLIED are excluded, unresolved PENDING aborts): " + priceOutcomeCounts + ". "
  339:                     + "The decision replay validates that originalDecision is audit-only and cannot override a non-null final decision. "
  340:                     + "Regression AnalysisService returns unsaved TradeSignal objects. Fresh signals then pass through an isolated shadow execution/position lifecycle that records exact simulated BUY/SELL points. Real wallet, trade_signal and production execution_opportunity tables are never written.";
  341: 
  342:             // FIX-087: one result row per run is an invariant. Worker ownership prevents the
  343:             // overlap at its source; this idempotent write is the database-level last safety net
  344:             // so a duplicate completion can never turn an otherwise valid replay into ERROR.
  345:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  346:                     INSERT INTO analysis_test_result
  347:                         (test_run_id,
  348:                          candles_1m, signals_1m_historical, replayable_1m_events, generated_signals_1m, generated_buys_1m,
  349:                          candles_5m, signals_5m_historical, replayable_5m_events, generated_signals_5m, generated_buys_5m,
  350:                          candles_1h, signals_1h_historical, replayable_1h_events, generated_signals_1h, generated_buys_1h,
  351:                          generated_signal_errors, simulated_trades, simulated_wins, simulated_losses,
  352:                          simulated_realized_pnl, simulated_final_wallet,
  353:                          decision_authority_corrections, old_hard_bearish_reversals,
  354:                          corrected_hard_bearish_reversals, cadence_path_passed, decision_authority_passed, test_passed, notes)
  355:                     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  356:                     ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  357:                         candles_1m=VALUES(candles_1m),
  358:                         signals_1m_historical=VALUES(signals_1m_historical),
  359:                         replayable_1m_events=VALUES(replayable_1m_events),
  360:                         generated_signals_1m=VALUES(generated_signals_1m),
  361:                         generated_buys_1m=VALUES(generated_buys_1m),
  362:                         candles_5m=VALUES(candles_5m),
  363:                         signals_5m_historical=VALUES(signals_5m_historical),
  364:                         replayable_5m_events=VALUES(replayable_5m_events),
  365:                         generated_signals_5m=VALUES(generated_signals_5m),
  366:                         generated_buys_5m=VALUES(generated_buys_5m),
  367:                         candles_1h=VALUES(candles_1h),
  368:                         signals_1h_historical=VALUES(signals_1h_historical),
  369:                         replayable_1h_events=VALUES(replayable_1h_events),
  370:                         generated_signals_1h=VALUES(generated_signals_1h),
  371:                         generated_buys_1h=VALUES(generated_buys_1h),
  372:                         generated_signal_errors=VALUES(generated_signal_errors),
  373:                         simulated_trades=VALUES(simulated_trades),
  374:                         simulated_wins=VALUES(simulated_wins),
  375:                         simulated_losses=VALUES(simulated_losses),
  376:                         simulated_realized_pnl=VALUES(simulated_realized_pnl),
  377:                         simulated_final_wallet=VALUES(simulated_final_wallet),
  378:                         decision_authority_corrections=VALUES(decision_authority_corrections),
  379:                         old_hard_bearish_reversals=VALUES(old_hard_bearish_reversals),
  380:                         corrected_hard_bearish_reversals=VALUES(corrected_hard_bearish_reversals),
  381:                         cadence_path_passed=VALUES(cadence_path_passed),
  382:                         decision_authority_passed=VALUES(decision_authority_passed),
  383:                         test_passed=VALUES(test_passed),
  384:                         notes=VALUES(notes)
  385:                     """,
  386:                     runId,
  387:                     requestedCandles1m, historical1m, replay1m, fresh.oneMinuteSignals(), fresh.oneMinuteBuys(),
  388:                     requestedCandles5m, historical5m, replay5m, fresh.fiveMinuteSignals(), fresh.fiveMinuteBuys(),
  389:                     requestedCandles1h, historical1h, replay1h, fresh.oneHourSignals(), fresh.oneHourBuys(),
  390:                     fresh.errors(), shadow.trades(), shadow.wins(), shadow.losses(), shadow.realizedPnl(), shadow.finalWallet(),
  391:                     authorityCorrections, oldHardReversals, correctedHardReversals,
  392:                     cadencePass, authorityPass, passed, notes
  393:             );
  394:             parityComparisonNs = System.nanoTime() - stageStartedNs;
  395: 
  396:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  397:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
  398:                     SET status=?, progress_percent=100, current_step=?, heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  399:                     WHERE id=?
  400:                     """, passed ? "PASSED" : "FAILED", passed ? "Regression checks passed" : "Regression checks failed", runId);
  401: 
  402:         } catch (ReplayCancellationException stop) {
  403:             // FIX-090: only mark ERROR after the replay pipeline has actually unwound to here.
  404:             // This makes ERROR a trustworthy signal that Delete Data may proceed once active_worker=false.
  405:             log.warn("FIX-090: regression test run {} stopped by user request", runId);
  406:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  407:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
  408:                     SET status='ERROR', current_step='Stopped by user',
  409:                         error_message='Replay stopped manually by user. Test data may now be deleted.',
  410:                         failure_step='Manual stop', failure_exception=NULL, failure_root_cause=NULL,
  411:                         failure_stack_trace=NULL, heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  412:                     WHERE id=?
  413:                     """, runId);
  414:         } catch (Exception exception) {
  415:             log.error("Regression test run {} failed", runId, exception);
  416:             String failedStep = currentStep(runId);
  417:             String summary = errorDetail(exception, 1900);
  418:             Throwable root = rootCause(exception);
  419:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  420:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
  421:                     SET status='ERROR', progress_percent=100, current_step='Regression test failed', heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  422:                         error_message=?, failure_step=?, failure_exception=?, failure_root_cause=?,
  423:                         failure_stack_trace=?, started_at=COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),
  424:                         completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  425:                     WHERE id=?
  426:                     """,
  427:                     summary, failedStep, exception.getClass().getName(),
  428:                     rootCauseDetail(root, 1000), stackTrace(exception), runId);
  429:         } finally {
  430:             // FIX-11J: persist one timing snapshot after the existing Replay path has completed or
  431:             // unwound. Diagnostics persistence is deliberately best-effort: it must never replace
  432:             // the Replay's real PASSED/FAILED/ERROR outcome or swallow the original exception.
  433:             long replayTotalNs = System.nanoTime() - replayTotalStartedNs;
  434:             persistReplayTimingsSafely(runId, loadHistoricalDataNs, verifyEventResolutionNs,
  435:                     buildReplayDatasetNs, generateFreshSignalsNs, shadowExecutionNs,
  436:                     parityComparisonNs, replayTotalNs);
  437: 
  438:             // FIX-087: always release ownership, including ERROR paths, so a genuinely stopped
  439:             // replay remains recoverable later using the same run id and original replay window.
  440:             activeRunIds.remove(runId);
  441:             stopRequestedRunIds.remove(runId);
  442:         }
  443:     }

  445:     private void persistReplayTimingsSafely(long runId, Long loadHistoricalDataNs,
  446:                                             Long verifyEventResolutionNs, Long buildReplayDatasetNs,
  447:                                             Long generateFreshSignalsNs, Long shadowExecutionNs,
  448:                                             Long parityComparisonNs, long replayTotalNs) {
  449:         try {
  450:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  451:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
  452:                     SET timing_load_historical_ns=?, timing_verify_event_resolution_ns=?,
  453:                         timing_build_replay_dataset_ns=?, timing_generate_fresh_signals_ns=?,
  454:                         timing_shadow_execution_ns=?, timing_parity_comparison_ns=?, timing_total_ns=?
  455:                     WHERE id=?
  456:                     """, loadHistoricalDataNs, verifyEventResolutionNs, buildReplayDatasetNs,
  457:                     generateFreshSignalsNs, shadowExecutionNs, parityComparisonNs, replayTotalNs, runId);
  458:         } catch (Exception timingPersistenceFailure) {
  459:             log.error("FIX-11J: unable to persist Replay timing diagnostics for run {}",
  460:                     runId, timingPersistenceFailure);
  461:         }
  462:     }
  463: 
  464:     /**
  465:      * FIX-11H: loads one immutable replay dataset. The prefix comes from the exact existing
  466:      * closed/as-of query, so missing candle gaps cannot shorten history. The forward segment
  467:      * explicitly requires closed=true. No Production caller reaches this method.
  468:      */
  469:     private ReplayDataset loadDataset(String symbol, String btcSymbol, Instant start, Instant end) {
  470:         Map<ReplayDataset.CandleKey, List<Candle>> candleMap = new HashMap<>();
  471:         Set<String> symbols = new LinkedHashSet<>(List.of(symbol, btcSymbol));
  472:         int historyLimit = technicalIndicatorService.regressionHistoryLimit();
  473:         for (String sym : symbols) {
  474:             for (String interval : List.of("1m", "5m", "1h")) {
  475:                 List<Candle> prefix = new java.util.ArrayList<>(candleRepository.findClosedCandlesAtOrBefore(
  476:                         sym, interval, start, PageRequest.of(0, historyLimit)));
  477:                 java.util.Collections.reverse(prefix);
  478:                 List<Candle> forward = candleRepository
  479:                         .findBySymbolAndIntervalCodeAndClosedTrueAndOpenTimeBetweenOrderByOpenTimeAsc(
  480:                                 sym, interval, start, end);
  481:                 List<Candle> merged = new java.util.ArrayList<>(prefix.size() + forward.size());
  482:                 merged.addAll(prefix);
  483:                 Instant prefixEnd = prefix.isEmpty() ? Instant.EPOCH : prefix.get(prefix.size() - 1).getOpenTime();
  484:                 forward.stream().filter(c -> c.getOpenTime().isAfter(prefixEnd)).forEach(merged::add);
  485:                 candleMap.put(new ReplayDataset.CandleKey(sym, interval), merged);
  486:                 log.info("FIX-11H dataset candles: symbol={}, interval={}, prefix={}, forward={}, merged={}",
  487:                         sym, interval, prefix.size(), forward.size(), merged.size());
  488:             }
  489:         }
  490: 
  491:         Map<ReplayDataset.SignalKey, Long> lineage = new HashMap<>();
  492:         // FIX-11H / FIX-112D: lineage is candle identity, not signal persistence timing.
  493:         // Recovery/backfilled Production signals can be generated hours after their candle, so
  494:         // generatedAt MUST NOT define this preload window. Select and match lineage by the same
  495:         // exact candleOpenTime identity used by ReplayDataset.sourceSignalId().
  496:         for (TradeSignal signal : signalRepository.findBySymbolAndCandleOpenTimeBetweenOrderByCandleOpenTimeAsc(symbol, start, end)) {
  497:             ReplayDataset.SignalKey key = new ReplayDataset.SignalKey(
  498:                     signal.getSymbol(), signal.getInterval(), signal.getCandleOpenTime());
  499:             Long previous = lineage.putIfAbsent(key, signal.getId());
  500:             if (previous != null && !previous.equals(signal.getId())) {
  501:                 throw new IllegalStateException("Replay lineage invariant violated for " + key
  502:                         + ": signalIds=" + previous + "," + signal.getId());
  503:             }
  504:         }
  505:         log.info("FIX-11H dataset lineage: symbol={}, entries={}", symbol, lineage.size());
  506:         return new ReplayDataset(candleMap, lineage);
  507:     }
  508: 
  509:     private List<Candle> candles(String symbol, String interval, Instant start, Instant end) {
  510:         return candleRepository.findBySymbolAndIntervalCodeAndOpenTimeBetweenOrderByOpenTimeAsc(
  511:                 symbol, interval, start, end);
  512:     }
  513: 
  514:     private int verifyEventResolution(long runId, String symbol, String interval, List<Candle> candles,
  515:                                       int progressStart, int progressEnd) {
  516:         int resolved = 0;
  517:         int size = candles.size();
  518:         for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
  519:             checkStopRequested(runId);
  520:             Candle candle = candles.get(i);
  521:             List<Candle> latestAtEvent = candleRepository.findClosedCandlesAtOrBefore(
  522:                     symbol, interval, candle.getOpenTime(), PageRequest.of(0, 1));
  523:             if (!latestAtEvent.isEmpty() && candle.getOpenTime().equals(latestAtEvent.get(0).getOpenTime())) {
  524:                 resolved++;
  525:             }
  526:             if (i % 25 == 0 && size > 0) {
  527:                 int p = progressStart + (int) Math.round((progressEnd - progressStart) * (i / (double) size));
  528:                 updateRun(runId, "RUNNING", p,
  529:                         "Replaying " + interval + " candle " + (i + 1) + "/" + size, null);
  530:             }
  531:         }
  532:         return resolved;
  533:     }
  534: 
  535:     private FreshReplayStats generateFreshSignals(
  536:             long runId,
  537:             String symbol,
  538:             Instant executionStart,
  539:             Instant executionEnd,
  540:             List<Candle> oneMinuteCandles,
  541:             List<Candle> fiveMinuteCandles,
  542:             List<Candle> oneHourCandles,
  543:             String btcSymbol,
  544:             List<Candle> btcOneMinuteCandles,
  545:             List<Candle> btcFiveMinuteCandles,
  546:             List<Candle> btcOneHourCandles,
  547:             ReplayDataSource dataSource,
  548:             ReplayDataset replayDataset
  549:     ) {
  550:         List<ReplayCandle> timeline = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  551:         oneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1m", c, true)));
  552:         fiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "5m", c, true)));
  553:         oneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1h", c, true)));
  554:         btcOneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1m", c, false)));
  555:         btcFiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "5m", c, false)));
  556:         btcOneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1h", c, false)));
  557:         timeline.sort(java.util.Comparator
  558:                 .comparing((ReplayCandle rc) -> rc.candle().getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(rc.interval())))
  559:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> intervalOrder(rc.interval()))
  560:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> rc.primary() ? 1 : 0));
  561: 
  562:         int oneMinuteSignals = 0, fiveMinuteSignals = 0, oneHourSignals = 0;
  563:         int oneMinuteBuys = 0, fiveMinuteBuys = 0, oneHourBuys = 0;
  564:         int buys = 0, watches = 0, sells = 0, strongSells = 0, errors = 0;
  565:         java.util.List<TradeSignal> generatedSignals = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  566: 
  567:         // FIX-11L: Replay-only deep profiling for the Generate fresh signals stage.
  568:         // These monotonic timers observe existing calls only; they do not alter inputs,
  569:         // call ordering, persistence, thresholds, or any Production trading behavior.
  570:         ReplayFreshSignalProfiler profiler = new ReplayFreshSignalProfiler(runId, dataSource);
  571:         // FIX-11M: Enable aggregate timing only for this Replay worker thread.
  572:         // The shared AnalysisService decision path is unchanged; this is observation-only.
  573:         analysisService.beginReplayAnalysisProfiling(runId);
  574:         try (ExecutionReplayScope.Scope ignored = replayScope.open(runId, List.of(), o -> {})) {
  575:         // FIX-043 Replay parity: fresh Replay has always generated technical snapshots/signals
  576:         // chronologically for EVERY closed candle in the timeline. Production now restores the
  577:         // same no-gap contract with asynchronous close-event processing plus chronological recovery.
  578:         // Do not "optimize" Replay by sampling every Nth candle or by copying the production recovery
  579:         // scheduler cadence; that would recreate the exact 1m->~5m blind-gap incident FIX-043 fixes.
  580:         for (int index = 0; index < timeline.size(); index++) {
  581:             checkStopRequested(runId);
  582:             ReplayCandle replay = timeline.get(index);
  583:             Candle candle = replay.candle();
  584:             Instant evaluationTime = candle.getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(replay.interval()));
  585:             boolean inRequestedWindow = !evaluationTime.isBefore(executionStart) && !evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd);
  586:             try {
  587:                 long operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  588:                 java.util.Optional<IndicatorSnapshot> snapshot;
  589:                 try {
  590:                     snapshot = dataSource == ReplayDataSource.DATASET
  591:                             ? technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
  592:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime(), replayDataset)
  593:                             : technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
  594:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime());
  595:                 } finally {
  596:                     profiler.recordSnapshot(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  597:                 }
  598:                 if (snapshot.isEmpty()) {
  599:                     if (inRequestedWindow) {
  600:                         errors++;
  601:                         saveGenerationError(runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle,
  602:                                 "Not enough historical candles to calculate the technical snapshot");
  603:                     }
  604:                     continue;
  605:                 }
  606: 
  607:                 // Do not generate a signal whose candle would only have closed after the
  608:                 // requested test end. Warm-up rows before executionStart are intentionally
  609:                 // generated for as-of context, but are not counted or displayed as test output.
  610:                 if (evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd)) continue;
  611: 
  612:                 replayScope.reference(evaluationTime);
  613:                 operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  614:                 TradeSignal generated;
  615:                 try {
  616:                     generated = analysisService.analyzeForRegression(snapshot.get(), evaluationTime);
  617:                 } finally {
  618:                     profiler.recordAnalysis(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  619:                 }
  620:                 replayScope.appendSignal(generated);
  621:                 SignalDecision decision = generated.getDecision();
  622:                 if (replay.primary()) generatedSignals.add(generated);
  623: 
  624:                 if (replay.primary() && inRequestedWindow) {
  625:                     if ("1m".equals(replay.interval())) { oneMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneMinuteBuys++; }
  626:                     else if ("5m".equals(replay.interval())) { fiveMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) fiveMinuteBuys++; }
  627:                     else if ("1h".equals(replay.interval())) { oneHourSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneHourBuys++; }
  628: 
  629:                     if (decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY) buys++;
  630:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.WATCH) watches++;
  631:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.SELL) sells++;
  632:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL) strongSells++;
  633: 
  634:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  635:                     try {
  636:                         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  637:                             INSERT INTO analysis_test_signal
  638:                                 (test_run_id, source_signal_id, replay_generated, symbol, interval_code, candle_open_time,
  639:                                  generated_at, latest_price, original_decision, final_decision,
  640:                                  execution_effective_decision, total_score, confidence_score, raw_confidence_score,
  641:                                  effective_confidence_score, primary_blocking_stage, detected_regime, candidate_regime,
  642:                                  confirmed_regime, regime_candidate_count, entry_authority, entry_authority_max_position_percent,
  643:                                  trend_score, volume_score, momentum_score, decision_authority_corrected, generation_error)
  644:                             VALUES (?, NULL, 1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, NULL)
  645:                             """,
  646:                             runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), Timestamp.from(candle.getOpenTime()),
  647:                             Timestamp.from(evaluationTime), generated.getLatestPrice(),
  648:                             generated.getOriginalDecision() == null ? null : generated.getOriginalDecision().name(),
  649:                             decision == null ? null : decision.name(),
  650:                             decision == null ? null : decision.name(),
  651:                             generated.getTotalScore(), generated.getConfidenceScore(), generated.getRawConfidenceScore(),
  652:                             generated.getEffectiveConfidenceScore(), generated.getPrimaryBlockingStage(),
  653:                             generated.getDetectedRegime() == null ? null : generated.getDetectedRegime().name(),
  654:                             generated.getCandidateRegime() == null ? null : generated.getCandidateRegime().name(),
  655:                             generated.getConfirmedRegime() == null ? null : generated.getConfirmedRegime().name(),
  656:                             generated.getRegimeCandidateCount(), generated.getEntryAuthority(),
  657:                             generated.getEntryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent(), generated.getTrendScore(),
  658:                             generated.getVolumeScore(), generated.getMomentumScore());
  659:                     } finally {
  660:                         profiler.recordAnalysisTestSignalPersistence(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  661:                     }
  662: 
  663:                     // FIX-069: Persist the exact production TradeSignal shape as replay output.
  664:                     // analysis_test_signal remains for backward-compatible diagnostics, while
  665:                     // trade_signal_test is the canonical parity table used for field-by-field comparison.
  666:                     // FIX-112D: Replay lineage uses exact market-candle identity, never
  667:                     // generated_at or nearest-time matching. A legitimate Replay-only
  668:                     // signal remains NULL. This metadata lookup cannot alter Production.
  669:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  670:                     Long sourceSignalId;
  671:                     try {
  672:                         sourceSignalId = dataSource == ReplayDataSource.DATASET
  673:                                 ? replayDataset.sourceSignalId(
  674:                                         generated.getSymbol(), generated.getInterval(), generated.getCandleOpenTime())
  675:                                 : signalRepository.findBySymbolAndIntervalAndCandleOpenTime(
  676:                                         generated.getSymbol(), generated.getInterval(), generated.getCandleOpenTime())
  677:                                         .map(TradeSignal::getId).orElse(null);
  678:                     } finally {
  679:                         profiler.recordLineageLookup(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  680:                     }
  681:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  682:                     try {
  683:                         persistTradeSignalTest(runId, generated, sourceSignalId, null);
  684:                     } finally {
  685:                         profiler.recordTradeSignalTestPersistence(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  686:                     }
  687:                 }
  688:             } catch (ReplayCancellationException stop) {
  689:                 throw stop;
  690:             } catch (Exception exception) {
  691:                 if (replay.primary() && inRequestedWindow) {
  692:                     errors++;
  693:                     saveGenerationError(runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle, errorDetail(exception, 900));
  694:                 }
  695:                 log.warn("Regression fresh-signal generation failed: run={}, symbol={}, interval={}, candle={}",
  696:                         runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime(), exception);
  697:             }
  698: 
  699:             if (index % 10 == 0 && !timeline.isEmpty()) {
  700:                 int progress = 43 + (int) Math.round(30d * index / timeline.size());
  701:                 long progressStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  702:                 try {
  703:                     updateRun(runId, "RUNNING", Math.min(73, progress),
  704:                             "Generating fresh signal " + (index + 1) + "/" + timeline.size(), null);
  705:                 } finally {
  706:                     profiler.recordProgressUpdate(System.nanoTime() - progressStartedNs);
  707:                 }
  708:             }
  709:         }
  710: 
  711:         } finally {
  712:             // FIX-11M must never turn a valid Replay into ERROR if diagnostic summary logging fails.
  713:             try {
  714:                 analysisService.finishReplayAnalysisProfiling(runId);
  715:             } catch (Exception profilingException) {
  716:                 log.warn("FIX11M_REPLAY_ANALYSIS_PROFILE_ERROR run={} message={} productionMutation=false replayDecisionMutation=false",
  717:                         runId, profilingException.getMessage());
  718:             }
  719:             profiler.logSummary(log, timeline.size());
  720:         }
  721:         return new FreshReplayStats(oneMinuteSignals, oneMinuteBuys, fiveMinuteSignals, fiveMinuteBuys,
  722:                 oneHourSignals, oneHourBuys, buys, watches, sells, strongSells, errors, generatedSignals);
  723:     }

  729:                      generated_at, latest_price, decision_authority_corrected, generation_error)
