  736:     /**
  737:      * FIX-069: write every field mapped by the TradeSignal JPA entity into trade_signal_test.
  738:      * Reflection is intentional here: whenever production TradeSignal gains another @Column,
  739:      * replay inherits it automatically instead of drifting behind a hand-maintained test schema.
  740:      */
  741:     private void persistTradeSignalTest(long runId, TradeSignal signal, Long sourceSignalId, String generationError) {
  742:         try {
  743:             java.util.List<String> columns = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  744:             java.util.List<Object> values = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  745:             columns.add("test_run_id"); values.add(runId);
  746:             // FIX-112D / Replay=Production audit lineage: this ID points only to the
  747:             // exact Production signal for the same symbol + interval + candle_open_time.
  748:             // It is additive Replay metadata and is never an execution authority.
  749:             columns.add("source_signal_id"); values.add(sourceSignalId);
  750:             columns.add("replay_generated"); values.add(1);
  751:             columns.add("generation_error"); values.add(generationError);
  752: 
  753:             for (Field field : TradeSignal.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
  754:                 if ("id".equals(field.getName()) || "createdAt".equals(field.getName())) continue;
  755:                 Column column = field.getAnnotation(Column.class);
  756:                 if (column == null) continue;
  757:                 field.setAccessible(true);
  758:                 Object value = field.get(signal);
  759:                 if (value instanceof Enum<?> e) value = e.name();
  760:                 if (value instanceof Instant instant) value = Timestamp.from(instant);
  761:                 String columnName = column.name();
  762:                 if (columnName == null || columnName.isBlank()) columnName = snakeCase(field.getName());
  763:                 columns.add(columnName);
  764:                 values.add(value);
  765:             }
  766: 
  767:             String placeholders = String.join(",", java.util.Collections.nCopies(values.size(), "?"));
  768:             jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO trade_signal_test (" + String.join(",", columns) + ") VALUES (" + placeholders + ")", values.toArray());
  769:         } catch (Exception e) {
  770:             throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to persist production-shaped replay TradeSignal", e);
  771:         }
  772:     }
  773: 
  774:     private String snakeCase(String value) {
  775:         return value.replaceAll("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "$1_$2").toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
  776:     }

  778:     private long intervalSeconds(String interval) {
  779:         return switch (interval) {
  780:             case "1m" -> 60L;
  781:             case "5m" -> 300L;
  782:             case "1h" -> 3600L;
  783:             default -> 60L;
  784:         };
  785:     }

  799:     /**
  800:      * FIX-11L Replay-only profiler for the fresh-signal generation loop. It deliberately
  801:      * aggregates timings in memory and emits one summary log after the stage; there are no
  802:      * per-signal log writes and no Production/shared-analysis branches.
  803:      */
  804:     private static final class ReplayFreshSignalProfiler {
  805:         private final long runId;
  806:         private final ReplayDataSource dataSource;
  807:         private final long startedNs = System.nanoTime();
  808:         private long snapshotNs;
  809:         private long analysisNs;
  810:         private long analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs;
  811:         private long lineageLookupNs;
  812:         private long tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs;
  813:         private long progressUpdateNs;
  814:         private long snapshotCalls;
  815:         private long analysisCalls;
  816:         private long analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls;
  817:         private long lineageLookupCalls;
  818:         private long tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls;
  819:         private long progressUpdateCalls;
  820:         private long maxSnapshotNs;
  821:         private long maxAnalysisNs;
  822: 
  823:         private ReplayFreshSignalProfiler(long runId, ReplayDataSource dataSource) {
  824:             this.runId = runId;
  825:             this.dataSource = dataSource;
  826:         }
  827: 
  828:         private void recordSnapshot(long elapsedNs) {
  829:             snapshotNs += elapsedNs;
  830:             snapshotCalls++;
  831:             maxSnapshotNs = Math.max(maxSnapshotNs, elapsedNs);
  832:         }
  833: 
  834:         private void recordAnalysis(long elapsedNs) {
  835:             analysisNs += elapsedNs;
  836:             analysisCalls++;
  837:             maxAnalysisNs = Math.max(maxAnalysisNs, elapsedNs);
  838:         }
  839: 
  840:         private void recordAnalysisTestSignalPersistence(long elapsedNs) {
  841:             analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs += elapsedNs;
  842:             analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls++;
  843:         }
  844: 
  845:         private void recordLineageLookup(long elapsedNs) {
  846:             lineageLookupNs += elapsedNs;
  847:             lineageLookupCalls++;
  848:         }
  849: 
  850:         private void recordTradeSignalTestPersistence(long elapsedNs) {
  851:             tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs += elapsedNs;
  852:             tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls++;
  853:         }
  854: 
  855:         private void recordProgressUpdate(long elapsedNs) {
  856:             progressUpdateNs += elapsedNs;
  857:             progressUpdateCalls++;
  858:         }
  859: 
  860:         private void logSummary(org.slf4j.Logger logger, int timelineSize) {
  861:             long totalNs = System.nanoTime() - startedNs;
  862:             long measuredNs = snapshotNs + analysisNs + analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs
  863:                     + lineageLookupNs + tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs + progressUpdateNs;
  864:             long otherNs = Math.max(0L, totalNs - measuredNs);
  865:             logger.info(
  866:                     "FIX11L_REPLAY_SIGNAL_PROFILE run={} dataSource={} timeline={} totalMs={} "
  867:                             + "snapshotMs={} snapshotCalls={} snapshotAvgMs={} snapshotMaxMs={} "
  868:                             + "analysisMs={} analysisCalls={} analysisAvgMs={} analysisMaxMs={} "
  869:                             + "analysisTestSignalPersistMs={} analysisTestSignalPersistCalls={} "
  870:                             + "lineageMs={} lineageCalls={} tradeSignalTestPersistMs={} tradeSignalTestPersistCalls={} "
  871:                             + "progressMs={} progressCalls={} otherMs={} productionMutation=false replayDecisionMutation=false",
  872:                     runId, dataSource, timelineSize, millis(totalNs),
  873:                     millis(snapshotNs), snapshotCalls, averageMillis(snapshotNs, snapshotCalls), millis(maxSnapshotNs),
  874:                     millis(analysisNs), analysisCalls, averageMillis(analysisNs, analysisCalls), millis(maxAnalysisNs),
  875:                     millis(analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs), analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls,
  876:                     millis(lineageLookupNs), lineageLookupCalls, millis(tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs),
  877:                     tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls, millis(progressUpdateNs), progressUpdateCalls, millis(otherNs));
  878:         }
  879: 
  880:         private static String millis(long ns) {
  881:             return String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", ns / 1_000_000.0d);
  882:         }
  883: 
  884:         private static String averageMillis(long ns, long calls) {
  885:             return calls == 0L ? "0.000"
  886:                     : String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", (ns / 1_000_000.0d) / calls);
  887:         }
  888:     }

  903:         return candles.stream()

  919:     private void updateRun(long runId, String status, int progress, String step, String error) {
  920:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  921:                 UPDATE analysis_test_run
  922:                 SET status=?, progress_percent=?, current_step=?, error_message=?,
  923:                     started_at=COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  924:                 WHERE id=?
  925:                 """, status, Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress)), step, error, runId);
  926:     }

  930:     private String currentStep(long runId) {
  931:         try {
  932:             return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
  933:                     "SELECT current_step FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id = ?", String.class, runId);
  934:         } catch (Exception ignored) {
  935:             return "Unknown regression phase";
  936:         }
  937:     }
  938: 
  939:     private Throwable rootCause(Throwable exception) {
  940:         if (exception == null) return null;
  941:         Throwable root = exception;
  942:         while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
  943:             root = root.getCause();
  944:         }
  945:         return root;
  946:     }
  947: 
  948:     private String rootCauseDetail(Throwable root, int max) {
  949:         if (root == null) return "Unknown root cause";
  950:         String message = root.getMessage();
  951:         String detail = root.getClass().getName() + (message == null || message.isBlank() ? "" : ": " + message);
  952:         return abbreviate(detail, max);
  953:     }
  954: 
  955:     private String stackTrace(Throwable exception) {
  956:         if (exception == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
  957:         StringWriter buffer = new StringWriter();
  958:         try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(buffer)) {
  959:             exception.printStackTrace(writer);
  960:         }
  961:         return buffer.toString();
  962:     }
  963: 
  964:     private Instant toInstant(Object value) {
  965:         if (value instanceof Timestamp timestamp) return timestamp.toInstant();
  966:         if (value instanceof Instant instant) return instant;
  967:         if (value instanceof LocalDateTime localDateTime) return localDateTime.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC);
  968:         throw new IllegalStateException("Unsupported regression timestamp value: " + value);
  969:     }
  970: 
  971: 
  972:     private String errorDetail(Throwable exception, int max) {
  973:         if (exception == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
  974:         Throwable root = exception;
  975:         while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
  976:             root = root.getCause();
  977:         }
  978:         StringBuilder detail = new StringBuilder()
  979:                 .append(exception.getClass().getName())
  980:                 .append(": ")
  981:                 .append(exception.getMessage() == null ? exception.toString() : exception.getMessage());
  982:         if (root != exception) {
  983:             detail.append(" | Root cause: ")
  984:                     .append(root.getClass().getName())
  985:                     .append(": ")
  986:                     .append(root.getMessage() == null ? root.toString() : root.getMessage());
  987:         }
  988:         return abbreviate(detail.toString(), max);
  989:     }
  990: 
  991:     private String abbreviate(String value, int max) {
  992:         if (value == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
  993:         return value.length() <= max ? value : value.substring(0, max);
  994:     }
  995: 
  996: 
  997: }

  115:     /**
  116:      * FIX-089: only rows that pre-date this service/JVM instance can be leftovers from a real
  117:      * application restart. FIX-088 updated every PENDING/RUNNING row when ApplicationReadyEvent
  118:      * fired, which could falsely mark a replay created by the current JVM as interrupted.
  119:      *
  120:      * Capturing the service construction time makes the distinction deterministic: a replay row
  121:      * created after this instant belongs to the current application instance and must never be
  122:      * touched by startup recovery, even if ApplicationReadyEvent is delivered later than expected.
  123:      */
  124:     private final Instant serviceInstanceStartedAt = Instant.now();

  126:     @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent.class)
  127:     public void markInterruptedRunsAfterRestart() {

  130:                 SET status='ERROR', current_step='Interrupted by application restart',
  131:                     error_message='Replay was interrupted by an actual application restart. Resume is disabled; delete test data and start a new run.',
  132:                     completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  133:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
  134:                   AND created_at < ?
  135:                 """, Timestamp.from(serviceInstanceStartedAt));

  139:     // mutates an existing failed run back to PENDING. Users delete test data and start a clean run.

  142:     /**
  143:      * FIX-090: request cooperative cancellation of exactly one active replay worker.
  144:      * We do not mark the row ERROR here because that would be a false claim while Java is
  145:      * still executing. RegressionTestWorker marks ERROR only after it actually unwinds.
  146:      */
  147:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> stopRun(long runId) {
  148:         List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
  149:                 "SELECT id,status,current_step FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id=?", runId);
  150:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Regression test #" + runId + " not found.");
  151:         String status = String.valueOf(rows.get(0).get("status"));
  152:         if (!("PENDING".equals(status) || "RUNNING".equals(status))) {
  153:             return Map.of("id", runId, "status", status, "activeWorker", worker.isActive(runId),
  154:                     "message", "Test is already stopped.");
  155:         }
  156:         boolean requested = worker.requestStop(runId);
  157:         if (!requested) {
  158:             // No worker in this JVM means it is already orphaned/stopped. Mark it ERROR now so
  159:             // Delete Data is not blocked forever by a stale RUNNING database status.
  160:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  161:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
  162:                     SET status='ERROR', current_step='Stopped by user',
  163:                         error_message='Replay worker was not active in this application instance; run marked stopped.',
  164:                         completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  165:                     WHERE id=? AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
  166:                     """, runId);
  167:             return Map.of("id", runId, "status", "ERROR", "activeWorker", false,
  168:                     "message", "Test had no active worker and is now stopped. You can Delete Data.");
  169:         }
  170:         jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE analysis_test_run SET current_step='Stop requested �?" waiting for replay worker to exit', heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=?", runId);
  171:         return Map.of("id", runId, "status", "STOPPING", "activeWorker", true,
  172:                 "message", "Stop requested. Delete Data will unlock after the replay worker has fully stopped.");
  173:     }

  179:     /** FIX-11H explicit replay-only OLD/NEW selector. Production is not configurable through this mode. */
  180:     public synchronized long start(RegressionTestRunRequest request, ReplayDataSource dataSource) {
  181:         if (request == null || request.symbol() == null || request.symbol().isBlank()
  182:                 || request.startTime() == null || request.endTime() == null
  183:                 || !request.endTime().isAfter(request.startTime())) {
  184:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Symbol, start time and end time are required, and end must be after start.");
  185:         }
  186: 
  187:         Integer activeRuns = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("""
  188:                 SELECT COUNT(*)
  189:                 FROM analysis_test_run
  190:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
  191:                 """, Integer.class);
  192:         if (activeRuns != null && activeRuns > 0) {
  193:             Map<String, Object> active = jdbcTemplate.queryForMap("""
  194:                     SELECT id, test_name, symbol, status, progress_percent, started_at, created_at
  195:                     FROM analysis_test_run
  196:                     WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
  197:                     ORDER BY id DESC
  198:                     LIMIT 1
  199:                     """);
  200:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
  201:                     "Regression test #" + active.get("id") + " is already " + active.get("status")
  202:                             + " for " + active.get("symbol") + ". Wait for it to finish before starting another run.");
  203:         }
  204: 
  205:         String symbol = request.symbol().trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
  206:         ReplayDataSource effectiveSource = dataSource == null ? ReplayDataSource.DATABASE : dataSource;
  207:         String baseTestName = request.testName() == null || request.testName().isBlank()
  208:                 ? symbol + " regression" : request.testName().trim();
  209:         String testName = (baseTestName + " [" + effectiveSource.name() + "]").substring(
  210:                 0, Math.min(180, baseTestName.length() + effectiveSource.name().length() + 3));
  211: 
  212:         KeyHolder keyHolder = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
  213:         jdbcTemplate.update(connection -> {
  214:             PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement("""
  215:                     INSERT INTO analysis_test_run
  216:                         (test_name, symbol, start_time, end_time, status, progress_percent, current_step)
  217:                     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', 0, 'Queued from Administration')
  218:                     """, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS);
  219:             statement.setString(1, testName);
  220:             statement.setString(2, symbol);
  221:             statement.setTimestamp(3, Timestamp.from(request.startTime()));
  222:             statement.setTimestamp(4, Timestamp.from(request.endTime()));
  223:             return statement;
  224:         }, keyHolder);
  225: 
  226:         Number key = keyHolder.getKey();
  227:         if (key == null) {
  228:             throw new IllegalStateException("Could not create regression test run.");
  229:         }
  230:         long id = key.longValue();
  231:         // FIX-156 / RET-01: do not persist a legacy shared experiment revision
  232:         // for baseline Replay. Its fixed parity policy is recorded by the
  233:         // immutable Replay profile/certificate work, not by FIX-122 state.
  234:         worker.runAsync(id, effectiveSource);
  235:         return id;

  239:     /**
  240:      * Archives one complete replay run before it can be cleared from the active test tables.
  241:      *
  242:      * IMPORTANT regression-history rule (introduced after the ETHUSDT Trade #2 investigation,
  243:      * Aug-2026): test rows are evidence. We must be able to rerun changed production logic without
  244:      * destroying the old pipeline/evidence/health/trade trace that still needs manual analysis.
  245:      * Proven trades remain separate in proven_analyzed_trade and are never moved or deleted here.

  247:     @Transactional
  248:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> archiveRun(long runId, String reason) {
  249:         Integer active = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id=? AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')", Integer.class, runId);
  250:         if (active != null && active > 0) {
  251:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Test #" + runId + " is still running and cannot be archived.");
  252:         }
  253:         List<Map<String,Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id,test_name,symbol,start_time,end_time,status FROM analysis_test_run WHERE id=?", runId);
  254:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Regression test #" + runId + " not found.");
  255:         List<Map<String,Object>> existing = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id FROM regression_test_archive_batch WHERE source_test_run_id=?", runId);
  256:         if (!existing.isEmpty()) return Map.of("archiveBatchId", existing.get(0).get("id"), "sourceTestRunId", runId, "alreadyArchived", true);
  257:         Map<String,Object> r = rows.get(0);
  258:         KeyHolder kh = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
  259:         jdbcTemplate.update(c -> {
  260:             PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement("INSERT INTO regression_test_archive_batch(source_test_run_id,test_name,symbol,start_time,end_time,source_status,archive_reason) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS);
  261:             ps.setLong(1, runId); ps.setString(2, String.valueOf(r.get("test_name"))); ps.setString(3, String.valueOf(r.get("symbol")));
  262:             ps.setTimestamp(4, (Timestamp) r.get("start_time")); ps.setTimestamp(5, (Timestamp) r.get("end_time"));
  263:             ps.setString(6, String.valueOf(r.get("status"))); ps.setString(7, reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? "Archived before replay reset" : reason.trim());
  264:             return ps;
  265:         }, kh);
  266:         long batchId = kh.getKey().longValue();
  267:         int runs = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO analysis_test_run_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM analysis_test_run r WHERE r.id=?", batchId, runId);
  268:         int signals = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO analysis_test_signal_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM analysis_test_signal r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  269:         // FIX-069: archive the full production-shaped replay signal snapshot as well.
  270:         int fullTradeSignals = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO trade_signal_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM trade_signal_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  271:         int opportunities = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO execution_opportunity_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM execution_opportunity_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  272:         int results = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO analysis_test_result_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM analysis_test_result r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  273:         int executions = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO wallet_execution_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM wallet_execution_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  274:         int positions = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO wallet_position_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM wallet_position_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  275:         int management = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO position_management_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM position_management_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  276:         int defensiveObservations = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  277:         int continuationGraceObservations = jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive SELECT ?, r.* FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test r WHERE r.test_run_id=?", batchId, runId);
  278:         return Map.ofEntries(
  279:                 Map.entry("archiveBatchId", batchId), Map.entry("sourceTestRunId", runId), Map.entry("alreadyArchived", false),
  280:                 Map.entry("runs", runs), Map.entry("signals", signals), Map.entry("tradeSignals", fullTradeSignals),
  281:                 Map.entry("opportunities", opportunities), Map.entry("results", results), Map.entry("executions", executions),

  314:     @Transactional
  315:     public synchronized Map<String, Object> resetAllTestData() {
  316:         // FIX-090: Java worker ownership is authoritative. Database ERROR may be written a few
  317:         // milliseconds before runAsync finally releases ownership; never purge during that gap.
  318:         if (worker.hasActiveRuns()) {
  319:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
  320:                     "A Replay/Test worker is still active. Stop it and wait for the worker to fully exit before Delete Data.");
  321:         }
  322:         Integer activeRuns = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("""
  323:                 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_test_run
  324:                 WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
  325:                 """, Integer.class);
  326:         if (activeRuns != null && activeRuns > 0) {
  327:             List<Map<String,Object>> liveRows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
  328:                     "SELECT id,status FROM analysis_test_run WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')");
  329:             boolean workerStillActive = liveRows.stream()
  330:                     .anyMatch(r -> worker.isActive(((Number) r.get("id")).longValue()));
  331:             if (workerStillActive) {
  332:                 throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
  333:                         "A Replay/Test worker is still active. Use Stop Test and wait until it becomes ERROR before Delete Data.");
  334:             }
  335:             // Defensive cleanup for a stale DB status with no Java worker.
  336:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  337:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run SET status='ERROR', current_step='Stopped/orphaned worker',
  338:                         error_message='No active Replay/Test worker exists in this application instance.',
  339:                         completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  340:                     WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
  341:                     """);
  342:         }
  343: 
  344:         // FIX-088: Delete Data is now a true purge, not an archive operation. Every replay/test
  345:         // table that can feed Recent Test Runs, run detail, Shadow Trades, or archived replay
  346:         // history is emptied. Persistent Proven records are deliberately excluded.
  347:         int provenBefore = countRows("proven_analyzed_trade");
  348:         int provenLegsBefore = countRows("proven_trade_leg_archive");
  349: 
  350:         Map<String, Integer> deleted = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
  351:         // Delete children before parents so the purge remains safe if foreign keys are added later.
  352:         deleted.put("one_candle_continuation_grace_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test"));
  353:         deleted.put("defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test"));
  354:         deleted.put("position_management_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM position_management_test"));
  355:         deleted.put("wallet_execution_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_execution_test"));
  356:         deleted.put("wallet_position_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_position_test"));
  357:         deleted.put("execution_opportunity_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM execution_opportunity_test"));
  358:         deleted.put("trade_signal_test", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM trade_signal_test"));
  359:         deleted.put("analysis_test_signal", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_signal"));
  360:         deleted.put("analysis_test_result", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_result"));
  361:         // FIX-156 / O-8: the only allowed shared diagnostic-table operation
  362:         // stays explicit and run-owned; it cannot delete a Production row.
  363:         deleted.put("fix122_evaluation", replayFix122EvaluationStore.purgeReplayRows());
  364:         deleted.put("analysis_test_run", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_run"));
  365: 
  366:         deleted.put("one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive"));
  367:         deleted.put("defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive"));
  368:         deleted.put("position_management_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM position_management_test_archive"));
  369:         deleted.put("wallet_execution_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_execution_test_archive"));
  370:         deleted.put("wallet_position_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM wallet_position_test_archive"));
  371:         deleted.put("execution_opportunity_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM execution_opportunity_test_archive"));
  372:         deleted.put("trade_signal_test_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM trade_signal_test_archive"));
  373:         deleted.put("analysis_test_signal_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_signal_archive"));
  374:         deleted.put("analysis_test_result_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_result_archive"));
  375:         deleted.put("analysis_test_run_archive", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM analysis_test_run_archive"));
  376:         deleted.put("regression_test_archive_batch", jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM regression_test_archive_batch"));
  377: 
  378:         // Validate the database state inside this same transaction. If any replay table still
  379:         // contains rows, throw and rollback instead of reporting a false successful purge.
  380:         java.util.List<String> replayTables = java.util.List.of(
  381:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", "position_management_test", "wallet_execution_test", "wallet_position_test",
  382:                 "execution_opportunity_test", "trade_signal_test", "analysis_test_signal",
  383:                 "analysis_test_result", "analysis_test_run",
  384:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test_archive", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test_archive", "position_management_test_archive", "wallet_execution_test_archive",
  385:                 "wallet_position_test_archive", "execution_opportunity_test_archive",
  386:                 "trade_signal_test_archive", "analysis_test_signal_archive",
  387:                 "analysis_test_result_archive", "analysis_test_run_archive",
  388:                 "regression_test_archive_batch");
  389:         Map<String, Integer> remaining = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
  390:         for (String table : replayTables) remaining.put(table, countRows(table));
  391:         java.util.List<String> nonEmpty = remaining.entrySet().stream()
  392:                 .filter(e -> e.getValue() != 0).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
  393:         if (!nonEmpty.isEmpty()) {
  394:             throw new IllegalStateException("Delete Test Data validation failed; rows remain in: " + String.join(", ", nonEmpty));
  395:         }
  396: 
  397:         int provenAfter = countRows("proven_analyzed_trade");
  398:         int provenLegsAfter = countRows("proven_trade_leg_archive");
  399:         if (provenBefore != provenAfter || provenLegsBefore != provenLegsAfter) {
  400:             throw new IllegalStateException("Delete Test Data validation failed; Proven records changed unexpectedly.");
  401:         }
  402: 
  403:         // Reset only tables that own an AUTO_INCREMENT id. This is cosmetic and happens only
  404:         // after successful delete + validation; Proven ids are never reset.
  405:         java.util.List<String> autoIncrementTables = java.util.List.of(
  406:                 "one_candle_continuation_grace_test", "defensive_risk_reduction_observation_test", "wallet_execution_test", "wallet_position_test", "position_management_test",
  407:                 "execution_opportunity_test", "trade_signal_test", "analysis_test_signal",
  408:                 "analysis_test_result", "analysis_test_run", "regression_test_archive_batch");
  409:         for (String table : autoIncrementTables) jdbcTemplate.execute("ALTER TABLE " + table + " AUTO_INCREMENT = 1");
  410: 
  411:         return Map.of(
  412:                 "success", true,
  413:                 "message", "All replay/test data deleted and validated; Proven trades preserved.",
  414:                 "deleted", deleted,
  415:                 "remaining", remaining,
  416:                 "provenTradesPreserved", provenAfter,
  417:                 "provenTradeLegsPreserved", provenLegsAfter
  418:         );
  419:     }

  423:         return count == null ? 0 : count;
  424:     }

  513:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
  514:     public Map<String, Object> allTradesChart(long runId, String interval) {
  515:         List<Map<String, Object>> runs = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
  516:                 SELECT id, symbol, start_time, end_time
  517:                 FROM analysis_test_run
  518:                 WHERE id = ?
  519:                 """, runId);
  520:         if (runs.isEmpty()) {
  521:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Replay run not found.");
  522:         }
  523: 
  524:         Map<String, Object> run = runs.get(0);

  656:     public Map<String, Object> archiveProvenTradeLeg(long provenTradeId, String requestedSide) {
  657:         String side = requestedSide == null ? "" : requestedSide.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
  658:         if (!side.equals("BUY") && !side.equals("SELL")) {
  659:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Archive side must be BUY or SELL.");
  660:         }
  661:         List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
  662:                 SELECT id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price,
  663:                        exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent

  666:                 """, provenTradeId);
  667:         if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Proven trade not found.");
  668:         Map<String, Object> trade = rows.get(0);
  669:         Object time = side.equals("BUY") ? trade.get("entry_time") : trade.get("exit_time");
  670:         Object price = side.equals("BUY") ? trade.get("entry_price") : trade.get("exit_price");
  671:         if (time == null || price == null) {
  672:             throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, side + " leg is not available for this proven trade.");
  673:         }

  675:                 INSERT INTO proven_trade_leg_archive
  676:                     (proven_trade_id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, side, execution_time, execution_price,
  677:                      exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent)

  679:                 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE execution_time=VALUES(execution_time), execution_price=VALUES(execution_price),
  680:                     exit_reason=VALUES(exit_reason), realized_pnl_usdt=VALUES(realized_pnl_usdt),
  681:                     realized_pnl_percent=VALUES(realized_pnl_percent), archived_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
  682:                 """, provenTradeId, trade.get("source_test_run_id"), trade.get("source_trade_id"), trade.get("symbol"),
  683:                 side, time, price, side.equals("SELL") ? trade.get("exit_reason") : null,
  684:                 side.equals("SELL") ? trade.get("realized_pnl_usdt") : null,
  685:                 side.equals("SELL") ? trade.get("realized_pnl_percent") : null);
  686:         return Map.of("archived", true, "provenTradeId", provenTradeId, "side", side);
  687:     }

  702:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
  703:     public Map<String, Object> provenTradeChart(String symbol, String interval) {
  704:         String normalized = symbol == null ? "" : symbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
  705:         String normalizedInterval = switch (interval == null ? "5m" : interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
  706:             case "1m", "5m", "1h", "4h" -> interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
  707:             default -> "5m";
  708:         };
  709:         List<Map<String, Object>> trades = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
  710:                 SELECT id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price,
  711:                        exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent, position_percent, marked_at
  712:                 FROM proven_analyzed_trade
  713:                 WHERE symbol = ?
  714:                 ORDER BY entry_time ASC
  715:                 LIMIT 250
  716:                 """, normalized);
  717:         java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, Map<String, Object>> candles = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
  718:         for (Map<String, Object> trade : trades) {
  719:             Timestamp entry = (Timestamp) trade.get("entry_time");
  720:             Timestamp exit = (Timestamp) trade.get("exit_time");
  721:             if (entry == null) continue;
  722:             // Proven-analysis charts intentionally use real historical candles with a wide context window.
  723:             // Keep seven hours before the BUY and seven hours after the SELL so manual review can
  724:             // detect late entries and premature exits instead of judging only the replay window.
  725:             Instant from = entry.toInstant().minus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
  726:             Instant to = (exit == null ? entry.toInstant() : exit.toInstant()).plus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
  727:             List<Map<String, Object>> segment = candleReader(jdbcTemplate).queryForList("""
  728:                     SELECT open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume
  729:                     FROM candle
  730:                     WHERE symbol=? AND interval_code=? AND closed=1 AND open_time BETWEEN ? AND ?
  731:                     ORDER BY open_time ASC
  732:                     """, normalized, normalizedInterval, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
  733:             for (Map<String, Object> c : segment) candles.put(String.valueOf(c.get("open_time")), c);
  734:         }
  735:         return Map.of("symbol", normalized, "interval", normalizedInterval, "trades", trades,
  736:                 "candles", new java.util.ArrayList<>(candles.values()));
  737:     }

  760:         if (normalized.isBlank() || from == null || to == null || !to.isAfter(from)) {

  762:         }

  764:                 SELECT open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume
  765:                 FROM candle

  767:                 ORDER BY open_time ASC
  768:                 """, normalized, normalizedInterval, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
  769:         return Map.of("symbol", normalized, "interval", normalizedInterval, "candles", candles);

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/regression/replay/ReplayAccessPolicy.java =====
    1: package com.crypto.regression.replay;
    2: 
    3: import java.util.Locale;
    4: import java.util.Map;
    5: import java.util.Set;
    6: 
    7: /**
    8:  * FIX-156: central allow-list for Replay-owned SQL names. This is deliberately
    9:  * independent from Production repositories and must be used by Replay-local stores.
   10:  */
   11: public final class ReplayAccessPolicy {
   12:     /** FIX-156: operation names are deliberately narrower than JDBC verbs. */
   13:     public enum Operation {
   14:         REPLAY_READ,
   15:         REPLAY_INSERT,
   16:         REPLAY_UPDATE,
   17:         REPLAY_DELETE,
   18:         MARKET_EVIDENCE_READ,
   19:         FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ,
   20:         FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT,
   21:         FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE,
   22:         FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ
   23:     }
   24: 
   25:     private static final Set<String> REPLAY_TABLES = Set.of(
   26:             "replay_policy_profile",
   27:             "replay_policy_profile_detail",
   28:             "replay_fixture",
   29:             "replay_run_output",
   30:             "replay_decision_trace",
   31:             "replay_run_certificate",
   32:             "replay_price_coverage");
   33: 
   34:     /** FIX-156: immutable historical evidence only; no account or wallet table belongs here. */
   35:     private static final Set<String> MARKET_EVIDENCE_TABLES = Set.of(
   36:             "candle",
   37:             "market_price_event",
   38:             "trade_signal",
   39:             "technical_indicator");
   40: 
   41:     private static final Map<Operation, Set<String>> FIX122_ALLOWED = Map.of(
   42:             Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"),
   43:             Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"),
   44:             Operation.FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"),
   45:             Operation.FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"));
   46: 
   47:     private ReplayAccessPolicy() {
   48:     }
   49: 
   50:     public static void requireReplayTable(String table) {
   51:         require(table, Operation.REPLAY_READ);
   52:     }
   53: 
   54:     /**
   55:      * FIX-156 / T156-09b: every Replay SQL operation must declare its approved
   56:      * category. This is intentionally not a generic shared-datasource interceptor.
   57:      */
   58:     public static void require(String table, Operation operation) {
   59:         String normalized = table == null ? "" : table.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
   60:         if (operation == null) deny(table, null);
   61:         boolean allowed = switch (operation) {
   62:             case REPLAY_READ, REPLAY_INSERT, REPLAY_UPDATE, REPLAY_DELETE -> REPLAY_TABLES.contains(normalized);
   63:             case MARKET_EVIDENCE_READ -> MARKET_EVIDENCE_TABLES.contains(normalized);
   64:             case FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ, FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT,
   65:                  FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE, FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ -> FIX122_ALLOWED
   66:                     .getOrDefault(operation, Set.of()).contains(normalized);
   67:         };
   68:         if (!allowed) deny(table, operation);
   69:     }
   70: 
   71:     /** FIX-156: make the O-8 predicates explicit at each JDBC call site. */
   72:     public static void requireFix122ActiveRunRead(String table, long runId) {
   73:         if (runId <= 0) deny(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ);
   74:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ);
   75:     }
   76: 
   77:     public static void requireFix122ActiveRunInsert(String table, long runId) {
   78:         if (runId <= 0) deny(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT);
   79:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT);
   80:     }
   81: 
   82:     public static void requireFix122ScopedPurge(String table) {
   83:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE);
   84:     }
   85: 
   86:     public static void requireFix122ProductionDisplayRead(String table) {
   87:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ);
   88:     }
   89: 
   90:     private static void deny(String table, Operation operation) {
   91:         throw new ReplayForbiddenDependencyException("table=" + table + ", operation=" + operation);
   92:     }
   93: }

    9: /** FIX-156: Replay-only persistence for an immutable historical policy profile. */
   10: @Repository

   18:     public ReplayPolicyProfile require(long runId) {
   19:         // FIX-156: never fall back to wallet_settings or current administration values.
   20:         ReplayAccessPolicy.require("replay_policy_profile", ReplayAccessPolicy.Operation.REPLAY_READ);
   21:         ReplayPolicyProfile profile = jdbc.query("""
   22:                 SELECT p.run_id, p.profile_hash, p.effective_at, p.dynamic_profit_lock_enabled,
   23:                        p.profit_lock_activation_percent, p.profit_lock_initial_percent,
   24:                        p.profit_lock_trail_step_percent, p.fixed_notional_usdt, d.policy_fingerprint,
   25:                        d.execution_profile, d.require_new_buy_transition, d.minimum_usdt_reserve,
   26:                        d.base_trade_amount_usdt, d.maximum_daily_new_positions,
   27:                        d.exchange_constraint_fixture_hash, d.minimum_executable_notional_usdt
   28:                 FROM replay_policy_profile p
   29:                 JOIN replay_policy_profile_detail d ON d.run_id=p.run_id
   30:                 WHERE p.run_id=?
   31:                 """, rs -> rs.next() ? new ReplayPolicyProfile(
   32:                 rs.getLong("run_id"), rs.getString("profile_hash"),
   33:                 rs.getTimestamp("effective_at").toInstant(),
   34:                 rs.getString("policy_fingerprint"), rs.getString("execution_profile"),
   35:                 rs.getBoolean("require_new_buy_transition"),
   36:                 rs.getBigDecimal("minimum_usdt_reserve"), rs.getBigDecimal("base_trade_amount_usdt"),
   37:                 rs.getInt("maximum_daily_new_positions"),
   38:                 rs.getString("exchange_constraint_fixture_hash"), rs.getBigDecimal("minimum_executable_notional_usdt"),
   39:                 rs.getBoolean("dynamic_profit_lock_enabled"),
   40:                 rs.getBigDecimal("profit_lock_activation_percent"),
   41:                 rs.getBigDecimal("profit_lock_initial_percent"),
   42:                 rs.getBigDecimal("profit_lock_trail_step_percent"),
   43:                 rs.getBigDecimal("fixed_notional_usdt")) : null, runId);
   44:         if (profile == null) {
   45:             throw new ReplayForbiddenDependencyException("FIX-156 missing frozen replay policy profile for run=" + runId);
   46:         }
   47:         return profile;
   48:     }
   49: 
   50:     @Transactional
   51:     public void insert(ReplayPolicyProfile profile) {
   52:         // FIX-156: fixtures are prepared outside the Replay execution boundary.
   53:         ReplayAccessPolicy.require("replay_policy_profile", ReplayAccessPolicy.Operation.REPLAY_INSERT);
   54:         int inserted = jdbc.update("""
   55:                 INSERT INTO replay_policy_profile
   56:                 (run_id, profile_hash, effective_at, dynamic_profit_lock_enabled,
   57:                  profit_lock_activation_percent, profit_lock_initial_percent,
   58:                  profit_lock_trail_step_percent, fixed_notional_usdt)
   59:                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
   60:                 """, profile.runId(), profile.profileHash(), Timestamp.from(profile.effectiveAt()),
   61:                 profile.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), profile.profitLockActivationPercent(),
   62:                 profile.profitLockInitialPercent(), profile.profitLockTrailStepPercent(),
   63:                 profile.fixedNotionalUsdt());
   64:         if (inserted != 1) {
   65:             throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-156 could not persist Replay policy profile");
   66:         }
   67:         ReplayAccessPolicy.require("replay_policy_profile_detail", ReplayAccessPolicy.Operation.REPLAY_INSERT);
   68:         int detailsInserted = jdbc.update("""
   69:                 INSERT INTO replay_policy_profile_detail
   70:                 (run_id, policy_fingerprint, execution_profile, require_new_buy_transition,
   71:                  minimum_usdt_reserve, base_trade_amount_usdt, maximum_daily_new_positions,
   72:                  exchange_constraint_fixture_hash, minimum_executable_notional_usdt)
   73:                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
   74:                 """, profile.runId(), profile.policyFingerprint(), profile.executionProfile(),
   75:                 profile.requireNewBuyTransition(), profile.minimumUsdtReserve(), profile.baseTradeAmountUsdt(),
   76:                 profile.maximumDailyNewPositions(), profile.exchangeConstraintFixtureHash(),

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/regression/replay/ReplayPolicyProfile.java =====
    1: package com.crypto.regression.replay;
    2: 
    3: import java.math.BigDecimal;
    4: import java.time.Instant;
    5: 
    6: /**
    7:  * FIX-156: immutable, as-of policy evidence consumed by Replay only.
    8:  * Production continues to read its live configuration through its own paths.
    9:  */
   10: public record ReplayPolicyProfile(
   11:         long runId,
   12:         String profileHash,
   13:         Instant effectiveAt,
   14:         String policyFingerprint,
   15:         String executionProfile,
   16:         boolean requireNewBuyTransition,
   17:         BigDecimal minimumUsdtReserve,
   18:         BigDecimal baseTradeAmountUsdt,
   19:         int maximumDailyNewPositions,
   20:         String exchangeConstraintFixtureHash,
   21:         BigDecimal minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt,
   22:         boolean dynamicProfitLockEnabled,
   23:         BigDecimal profitLockActivationPercent,
   24:         BigDecimal profitLockInitialPercent,
   25:         BigDecimal profitLockTrailStepPercent,
   26:         BigDecimal fixedNotionalUsdt) {
   27: 
   28:     public ReplayPolicyProfile {
   29:         if (runId <= 0 || profileHash == null || profileHash.isBlank()) {
   30:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-156 Replay policy profile hash is required");
   31:         }
   32:         if (effectiveAt == null || policyFingerprint == null || policyFingerprint.isBlank()
   33:                 || executionProfile == null || executionProfile.isBlank()
   34:                 || fixedNotionalUsdt == null || fixedNotionalUsdt.signum() <= 0
   35:                 || minimumUsdtReserve == null || minimumUsdtReserve.signum() < 0
   36:                 || baseTradeAmountUsdt == null || baseTradeAmountUsdt.signum() < 0
   37:                 || maximumDailyNewPositions < 0
   38:                 || exchangeConstraintFixtureHash == null || exchangeConstraintFixtureHash.isBlank()
   39:                 || minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt == null || minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt.signum() <= 0
   40:                 || profitLockActivationPercent == null || profitLockInitialPercent == null
   41:                 || profitLockTrailStepPercent == null) {
   42:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-156 Replay policy profile is incomplete");
   43:         }
   44:         validatePercent("profitLockActivationPercent", profitLockActivationPercent);
   45:         validatePercent("profitLockInitialPercent", profitLockInitialPercent);
   46:         validatePercent("profitLockTrailStepPercent", profitLockTrailStepPercent);
   47:     }
   48: 
   49:     private static void validatePercent(String name, BigDecimal value) {
   50:         if (value.signum() < 0 || value.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(100)) > 0) {
   51:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-156 " + name + " is outside 0..100");
   52:         }
   53:     }
   54: }

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/regression/replay/ReplayFix122EvaluationStore.java =====
    1: package com.crypto.regression.replay;
    2: 
    3: import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    4: import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    5: 
    6: import java.sql.Timestamp;
    7: import java.time.Instant;
    8: import java.util.List;
    9: import java.util.Map;
   10: 
   11: /**
   12:  * FIX-156 / O-8: the only Replay-owned gateway for the exceptional shared
   13:  * diagnostics table. None of these operations may supply decision authority.
   14:  */
   15: @Repository
   16: public class ReplayFix122EvaluationStore {
   17:     private static final String TABLE = "fix122_evaluation";
   18:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
   19: 
   20:     public ReplayFix122EvaluationStore(JdbcTemplate jdbc) {
   21:         this.jdbc = jdbc;
   22:     }
   23: 
   24:     public void appendActiveRun(long runId, String symbol, Long signalId, Instant at, String stage, String payload) {
   25:         ReplayAccessPolicy.requireFix122ActiveRunInsert(TABLE, runId);
   26:         jdbc.update("""
   27:                 INSERT INTO fix122_evaluation(test_run_id,symbol,signal_id,evaluated_at,stage,payload)
   28:                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)
   29:                 """, runId, symbol, signalId, Timestamp.from(at), stage, payload);
   30:     }
   31: 
   32:     public List<Map<String, Object>> activeRunDetails(long runId) {
   33:         ReplayAccessPolicy.requireFix122ActiveRunRead(TABLE, runId);
   34:         return jdbc.queryForList("SELECT * FROM fix122_evaluation WHERE test_run_id=? ORDER BY id", runId);
   35:     }
   36: 
   37:     public int purgeReplayRows() {
   38:         ReplayAccessPolicy.requireFix122ScopedPurge(TABLE);
   39:         return jdbc.update("DELETE FROM fix122_evaluation WHERE test_run_id IS NOT NULL");
   40:     }
   41: 
   42:     /** Display only; caller must not feed this result to state, fixture, or parity logic. */
   43:     public List<Map<String, Object>> productionDisplayDetails(String symbol, Instant from, Instant to) {
   44:         ReplayAccessPolicy.requireFix122ProductionDisplayRead(TABLE);
   45:         return jdbc.queryForList("""
   46:                 SELECT * FROM fix122_evaluation WHERE test_run_id IS NULL AND symbol=?
   47:                 AND evaluated_at>=? AND evaluated_at<=? ORDER BY id
   48:                 """, symbol, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
   49:     }
   50: }

agent-docs\FINAL_CHANGE_SPECIFICATION_RPR-0.9.1.md:36:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\handoff\ORIGINAL_CONTEXT.md:36:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:72:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:1232:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:2667:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.prompt.txt:60:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-claude.prompt.txt:60:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round01-codex.stderr.txt:72:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/regression/replay/ReplayAccessPolicy.java =====
    1: package com.crypto.regression.replay;
    2: 
    3: import java.util.Locale;
    4: import java.util.Map;
    5: import java.util.Set;
    6: 
    7: /**
    8:  * FIX-156: central allow-list for Replay-owned SQL names. This is deliberately
    9:  * independent from Production repositories and must be used by Replay-local stores.
   10:  */
   11: public final class ReplayAccessPolicy {
   12:     /** FIX-156: operation names are deliberately narrower than JDBC verbs. */
   13:     public enum Operation {
   14:         REPLAY_READ,
   15:         REPLAY_INSERT,
   16:         REPLAY_UPDATE,
   17:         REPLAY_DELETE,
   18:         MARKET_EVIDENCE_READ,
   19:         FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ,
   20:         FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT,
   21:         FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE,
   22:         FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ
   23:     }
   24: 
   25:     private static final Set<String> REPLAY_TABLES = Set.of(
   26:             "replay_policy_profile",
   27:             "replay_policy_profile_detail",
   28:             "replay_fixture",
   29:             "replay_run_output",
   30:             "replay_decision_trace",
   31:             "replay_run_certificate",
   32:             "replay_price_coverage");
   33: 
   34:     /** FIX-156: immutable historical evidence only; no account or wallet table belongs here. */
   35:     private static final Set<String> MARKET_EVIDENCE_TABLES = Set.of(
   36:             "candle",
   37:             "market_price_event",
   38:             "trade_signal",
   39:             "technical_indicator");
   40: 
   41:     private static final Map<Operation, Set<String>> FIX122_ALLOWED = Map.of(
   42:             Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"),
   43:             Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"),
   44:             Operation.FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"),
   45:             Operation.FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ, Set.of("fix122_evaluation"));
   46: 
   47:     private ReplayAccessPolicy() {
   48:     }
   49: 
   50:     public static void requireReplayTable(String table) {
   51:         require(table, Operation.REPLAY_READ);
   52:     }
   53: 
   54:     /**
   55:      * FIX-156 / T156-09b: every Replay SQL operation must declare its approved
   56:      * category. This is intentionally not a generic shared-datasource interceptor.
   57:      */
   58:     public static void require(String table, Operation operation) {
   59:         String normalized = table == null ? "" : table.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
   60:         if (operation == null) deny(table, null);
   61:         boolean allowed = switch (operation) {
   62:             case REPLAY_READ, REPLAY_INSERT, REPLAY_UPDATE, REPLAY_DELETE -> REPLAY_TABLES.contains(normalized);
   63:             case MARKET_EVIDENCE_READ -> MARKET_EVIDENCE_TABLES.contains(normalized);
   64:             case FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ, FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT,
   65:                  FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE, FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ -> FIX122_ALLOWED
   66:                     .getOrDefault(operation, Set.of()).contains(normalized);
   67:         };
   68:         if (!allowed) deny(table, operation);
   69:     }
   70: 
   71:     /** FIX-156: make the O-8 predicates explicit at each JDBC call site. */
   72:     public static void requireFix122ActiveRunRead(String table, long runId) {
   73:         if (runId <= 0) deny(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ);
   74:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_READ);
   75:     }
   76: 
   77:     public static void requireFix122ActiveRunInsert(String table, long runId) {
   78:         if (runId <= 0) deny(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT);
   79:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_ACTIVE_RUN_INSERT);
   80:     }
   81: 
   82:     public static void requireFix122ScopedPurge(String table) {
   83:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_SCOPED_PURGE);
   84:     }
   85: 
   86:     public static void requireFix122ProductionDisplayRead(String table) {
   87:         require(table, Operation.FIX122_PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READ);
   88:     }
   89: 
   90:     private static void deny(String table, Operation operation) {
   91:         throw new ReplayForbiddenDependencyException("table=" + table + ", operation=" + operation);
   92:     }
   93: }

    6: /**
    7:  * FIX-156: immutable, as-of policy evidence consumed by Replay only.
    8:  * Production continues to read its live configuration through its own paths.
    9:  */
   10: public record ReplayPolicyProfile(
   11:         long runId,
   12:         String profileHash,
   13:         Instant effectiveAt,
   14:         String policyFingerprint,
   15:         String executionProfile,
   16:         boolean requireNewBuyTransition,
   17:         BigDecimal minimumUsdtReserve,
   18:         BigDecimal baseTradeAmountUsdt,
   19:         int maximumDailyNewPositions,
   20:         String exchangeConstraintFixtureHash,
   21:         BigDecimal minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt,
   22:         boolean dynamicProfitLockEnabled,
   23:         BigDecimal profitLockActivationPercent,
   24:         BigDecimal profitLockInitialPercent,
   25:         BigDecimal profitLockTrailStepPercent,
   26:         BigDecimal fixedNotionalUsdt) {
   27: 
   28:     public ReplayPolicyProfile {
   29:         if (runId <= 0 || profileHash == null || profileHash.isBlank()) {
   30:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-156 Replay policy profile hash is required");
   31:         }
   32:         if (effectiveAt == null || policyFingerprint == null || policyFingerprint.isBlank()
   33:                 || executionProfile == null || executionProfile.isBlank()
   34:                 || fixedNotionalUsdt == null || fixedNotionalUsdt.signum() <= 0
   35:                 || minimumUsdtReserve == null || minimumUsdtReserve.signum() < 0
   36:                 || baseTradeAmountUsdt == null || baseTradeAmountUsdt.signum() < 0
   37:                 || maximumDailyNewPositions < 0
   38:                 || exchangeConstraintFixtureHash == null || exchangeConstraintFixtureHash.isBlank()
   39:                 || minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt == null || minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt.signum() <= 0
   40:                 || profitLockActivationPercent == null || profitLockInitialPercent == null
   41:                 || profitLockTrailStepPercent == null) {
   42:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-156 Replay policy profile is incomplete");
   43:         }
   44:         validatePercent("profitLockActivationPercent", profitLockActivationPercent);
   45:         validatePercent("profitLockInitialPercent", profitLockInitialPercent);
   46:         validatePercent("profitLockTrailStepPercent", profitLockTrailStepPercent);
   47:     }
   48: 
   49:     private static void validatePercent(String name, BigDecimal value) {
   50:         if (value.signum() < 0 || value.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(100)) > 0) {
   51:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("FIX-156 " + name + " is outside 0..100");
   52:         }
   53:     }
   54: }

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/regression/replay/ReplaySizingPolicy.java =====
    1: package com.crypto.regression.replay;
    2: 
    3: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    4: 
    5: import java.math.BigDecimal;
    6: import java.math.RoundingMode;
    7: 
    8: /**
    9:  * FIX-156: Replay-only mirror of the approved sizing arithmetic. It consumes a
   10:  * frozen profile and deliberately has no wallet repository dependency.
   11:  */
   12: @Component
   13: public final class ReplaySizingPolicy {
   14:     private static final BigDecimal ZERO = BigDecimal.ZERO;
   15:     private static final int SCALE = 12;
   16: 
   17:     public Plan plan(BigDecimal availableUsdt, BigDecimal minimumReserve, BigDecimal dailyTradeBudget,
   18:                      int requestedPositionPercent, int currentAllocatedPercent,
   19:                      boolean newPosition, int maximumNewPositions, int executedNewPositions,
   20:                      BigDecimal price) {
   21:         int requested = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, requestedPositionPercent));
   22:         int current = Math.max(0, currentAllocatedPercent);
   23:         int normalized = Math.min(requested, Math.max(0, 100 - current));
   24:         if (normalized <= 0) return Plan.reject("ALLOCATION_FULL");
   25:         if (newPosition && maximumNewPositions > 0 && executedNewPositions >= maximumNewPositions) {
   26:             return Plan.reject("DAILY_POSITION_LIMIT");
   27:         }
   28:         BigDecimal available = value(availableUsdt).subtract(value(minimumReserve)).max(ZERO);
   29:         BigDecimal spend = value(dailyTradeBudget).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(normalized))
   30:                 .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), SCALE, RoundingMode.DOWN);
   31:         if (spend.signum() <= 0) return Plan.reject("ZERO_BUDGET");
   32:         if (available.compareTo(spend) < 0) return Plan.reject("INSUFFICIENT_USDT_ABOVE_RESERVE");
   33:         if (price == null || price.signum() <= 0) return Plan.reject("INVALID_PRICE");
   34:         BigDecimal quantity = spend.divide(price, SCALE, RoundingMode.DOWN);
   35:         return quantity.signum() <= 0 ? Plan.reject("ZERO_QUANTITY")
   36:                 : new Plan(true, normalized, spend, quantity, "APPROVED");
   37:     }
   38: 
   39:     public BigDecimal initialDailyBudget(BigDecimal availableUsdt, BigDecimal minimumReserve,
   40:                                          BigDecimal baseTradeAmount, int maximumNewPositions) {
   41:         BigDecimal tradable = value(availableUsdt).subtract(value(minimumReserve)).max(ZERO);
   42:         if (tradable.signum() <= 0) return ZERO;
   43:         return maximumNewPositions == 0 ? value(baseTradeAmount).min(tradable)
   44:                 : tradable.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(maximumNewPositions), SCALE, RoundingMode.DOWN);
   45:     }
   46: 
   47:     private BigDecimal value(BigDecimal input) { return input == null ? ZERO : input; }
   48: 
   49:     public record Plan(boolean allowed, int normalizedPositionPercent, BigDecimal spend,
   50:                        BigDecimal quantity, String code) {
   51:         private static Plan reject(String code) { return new Plan(false, 0, ZERO, ZERO, code); }
   52:     }
   53: }

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/regression/replay/ReplayMinimumExecutionPolicy.java =====
    1: package com.crypto.regression.replay;
    2: 
    3: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    4: 
    5: import java.math.BigDecimal;
    6: import java.math.MathContext;
    7: 
    8: /** FIX-156: immutable-fixture minimum-order policy; never calls Binance. */
    9: @Component
   10: public final class ReplayMinimumExecutionPolicy {
   11:     private static final MathContext MC = MathContext.DECIMAL64;
   12: 
   13:     public Evaluation evaluate(BigDecimal minimumNotional, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal price) {
   14:         if (minimumNotional == null || minimumNotional.signum() <= 0
   15:                 || quantity == null || quantity.signum() <= 0 || price == null || price.signum() <= 0) {
   16:             return new Evaluation(false, "MISSING_OR_INVALID_REPLAY_CONSTRAINT", BigDecimal.ZERO, minimumNotional);
   17:         }
   18:         BigDecimal requested = quantity.multiply(price, MC);
   19:         return requested.compareTo(minimumNotional) < 0
   20:                 ? new Evaluation(false, "BELOW_BINANCE_MINIMUM", requested, minimumNotional)
   21:                 : new Evaluation(true, "EXECUTABLE", requested, minimumNotional);
   22:     }
   23: 
   24:     public record Evaluation(boolean executable, String code, BigDecimal requestedNotional,
   25:                              BigDecimal minimumNotional) { }
   26: }

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/regression/replay/ReplaySellValidationPolicy.java =====
    1: package com.crypto.regression.replay;
    2: 
    3: import com.crypto.domain.SignalDecision;
    4: import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
    5: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    6: 
    7: import java.time.Duration;
    8: 
    9: /** FIX-156: frozen Replay-local mirror of the Production 1m SELL context rules. */
   10: @Component
   11: public final class ReplaySellValidationPolicy {
   12:     private static final Duration FIVE_MINUTE_MAX_AGE = Duration.ofMinutes(20);
   13:     private static final Duration ONE_HOUR_MAX_AGE = Duration.ofHours(3);
   14: 
   15:     public Result validate(TradeSignal signal, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour) {
   16:         if (signal == null || signal.getGeneratedAt() == null) return Result.reject("INVALID_SIGNAL");
   17:         if (!"1m".equals(signal.getInterval())) return Result.reject("NON_EXECUTION_TIMEFRAME");
   18:         if (!bearish(signal.getDecision())) return Result.reject("NOT_SELL");
   19:         if (!fresh(fiveMinute, signal, FIVE_MINUTE_MAX_AGE)) return Result.reject("MISSING_5M_CONFIRMATION");
   20:         if (!bearish(fiveMinute.getDecision())) return Result.reject("5M_NOT_BEARISH");
   21:         if (!fresh(oneHour, signal, ONE_HOUR_MAX_AGE)) return Result.reject("MISSING_1H_CONTEXT");
   22:         if (bullish(oneHour.getDecision())) return Result.reject("1H_BULLISH_VETO");
   23:         return new Result(true, "SELL_CONFIRMED", "1m SELL confirmed by fresh bearish 5m context; 1h is not bullish.");
   24:     }
   25: 
   26:     private boolean fresh(TradeSignal candidate, TradeSignal reference, Duration maximumAge) {
   27:         return candidate != null && candidate.getGeneratedAt() != null
   28:                 && !candidate.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(reference.getGeneratedAt())
   29:                 && !candidate.getGeneratedAt().isBefore(reference.getGeneratedAt().minus(maximumAge));
   30:     }
   31: 
   32:     private boolean bearish(SignalDecision decision) {
   33:         return decision == SignalDecision.SELL || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL;
   34:     }
   35: 
   36:     private boolean bullish(SignalDecision decision) {
   37:         return decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY;
   38:     }
   39: 
   40:     public record Result(boolean allowed, String code, String explanation) {
   41:         private static Result reject(String code) { return new Result(false, code, code); }
   42:     }
   43: }
