  543:     private ExitDecision evaluateExit(long runId, ShadowPosition p, TradeSignal s, TradeSignal oneMinute, TradeSignal five, TradeSignal one) {
  544:         BigDecimal price = s.getLatestPrice();
  545:         if (price == null) return ExitDecision.hold();
  546: 
  547:         // Replay uses the exact same temporal price-authority rule as production. A signal
  548:         // generated later may still carry a candle close from before entry; that historical
  549:         // price may update MTF context but may not retroactively hit TP/SL/profit-lock.
  550:         boolean authoritativePrice = priceAuthorityPolicy.canUseSignalPrice(s, p.entryTime());
  551:         if (authoritativePrice && p.takeProfit() != null && price.compareTo(p.takeProfit()) >= 0) {
  552:             // Exact production TP-continuation call, including immutable entry structure.
  553:             // FIX-011 regression relies on Replay and live using this same shared policy.
  554:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(
  555:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one,
  556:                     p.entryTrend(), p.entryStructure(), p.entryMomentum(), p.entryVolume(),
  557:                     p.entryConfidence(), p.entryScore());
  558:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
  559:                 BigDecimal distance = p.takeProfit().subtract(p.entryPrice());
  560:                 BigDecimal newTarget = p.takeProfit().add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
  561:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXTENDED", p.takeProfit(), newTarget, p, continuation.explanation());
  562:                 jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET take_profit_usdt=? WHERE id=?", newTarget, p.positionId());
  563:                 return new ExitDecision(false, "EXTEND_TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation(), newTarget);
  564:             }
  565:             persistManagement(runId, s, "TAKE_PROFIT_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), p, continuation.explanation());
  566:             return new ExitDecision(true, "TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation());
  567:         }
  568:         // FIX-052 fallback ordering also mirrors Production: STOP_LOSS is absolute and
  569:         // is evaluated before profit-lock. Exact V64 runs normally take this path from
  570:         // persisted live-price events rather than from signal-carried prices.
  571:         if (authoritativePrice && p.stopLoss() != null && price.compareTo(p.stopLoss()) <= 0)
  572:             return new ExitDecision(true, "STOP_LOSS", "Price reached the stored stop loss.");
  573: 
  574:         ShadowPosition updated = authoritativePrice ? profitLockState(p, price) : p;
  575:         if (authoritativePrice && (updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE
  576:                 || updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  577:                 || p.profitLockActive() != updated.profitLockActive()
  578:                 || !equalsNullable(p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice())
  579:                 || p.profitLockState() != updated.profitLockState())) {
  580:             BigDecimal fix118Progress = updated.takeProfit() == null || updated.takeProfit().compareTo(updated.entryPrice()) <= 0
  581:                     ? BigDecimal.ZERO
  582:                     : updated.highest().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC)
  583:                             .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
  584:                             .divide(updated.takeProfit().subtract(updated.entryPrice(), MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  585:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_PATH] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, " +
  586:                             "entry={}, target={}, highest={}, previousActive={}, active={}, previousState={}, state={}, previousLock={}, lock={}, progressPct={}, triggered={}",
  587:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
  588:                     updated.entryPrice(), updated.takeProfit(), updated.highest(), p.profitLockActive(), updated.profitLockActive(),
  589:                     p.profitLockState(), updated.profitLockState(), p.profitLockPrice(), updated.profitLockPrice(), fix118Progress,
  590:                     updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
  591:                             && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0);
  592:         }
  593:         BigDecimal minimumProfitableExit = p.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005));
  594:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  595:                 && price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
  596:             String floorReason = "TP-extension rebase safety floor was breached at " + minimumProfitableExit + ". "
  597:                     + profitLockConfigText();
  598:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_REBASE_HARD_FLOOR] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, floor={}",
  599:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price, minimumProfitableExit);
  600:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
  601:             return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
  602:         }
  603:         if (authoritativePrice && updated.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE && updated.profitLockPrice() != null
  604:                 && price.compareTo(updated.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
  605:             log.info("[FIX-118][REPLAY][SIGNAL_TRIGGER] runId={}, positionId={}, signalId={}, symbol={}, generatedAt={}, price={}, lock={}, target={}",
  606:                     runId, updated.positionId(), s.getId(), s.getSymbol(), s.getGeneratedAt(), price,
  607:                     updated.profitLockPrice(), updated.takeProfit());
  608:             if (price.compareTo(minimumProfitableExit) < 0) {
  609:                 String floorReason = "Profit-lock hard floor was breached; protected profit can no longer be preserved. "
  610:                         + profitLockConfigText();
  611:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, floorReason);
  612:                 return new ExitDecision(true, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", floorReason);
  613:             }
  614:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lockDecision = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(
  615:                     oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
  616:             if (!lockDecision.exit()) {
  617:                 String holdReason = lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
  618:                 persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, holdReason);
  619:                 return ExitDecision.hold();
  620:             }
  621:             String lockReason = "Price retraced to the protected profit level after a profitable advance. "
  622:                     + lockDecision.explanation() + " " + profitLockConfigText();
  623:             persistManagement(runId, s, "PROFIT_LOCK_EXIT", p.takeProfit(), p.takeProfit(), updated, lockReason);
  624:             return new ExitDecision(true, lockDecision.code(), lockReason);
  625:         }
  626:         // Production has two SELL authorities: the live HTF PositionExitPolicy and the
  627:         // 1m signal TradeExecutionValidationService. Replay executes both shared production
  628:         // policies in the same order instead of carrying a test-only SELL rule.
  629:         PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation normalExit = exitPolicy.evaluateNormalExit(
  630:                 oneMinute != null ? oneMinute : s, five, one);
  631:         if (normalExit.exit()) {
  632:             return new ExitDecision(true, normalExit.code(), normalExit.explanation());
  633:         }
  634:         if ("1m".equals(s.getInterval()) && bearish(s.getDecision())) {
  635:             ReplaySellValidationPolicy.Result validatedSell = replaySellValidationPolicy.validate(s, five, one);
  636:             if (validatedSell.allowed()) {
  637:                 return new ExitDecision(true, validatedSell.code(), validatedSell.explanation());
  638:             }
  639:         }
  640:         return ExitDecision.hold();
  641:     }

  643:     private FallbackNearTpEvaluation evaluateNearTpAtSignalFallback(long runId, ShadowPosition current,
  644:                                                                     TradeSignal signal, TradeSignal oneMinute,
  645:                                                                     TradeSignal fiveMinute) {
  646:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State state = new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
  647:                 current.nearTpState(), current.nearTpBestPrice(), current.nearTpBearishStreak(),
  648:                 current.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), current.nearTpHarvestUsed());
  649:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.Evaluation evaluation = nearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.evaluate(
  650:                 state, current.entryPrice(), current.takeProfit(), signal.getLatestPrice(), signal.getGeneratedAt(),
  651:                 oneMinute, fiveMinute);
  652:         ShadowPosition updated = current.withNearTp(evaluation.state());
  653:         if (!updated.sameNearTp(current)) persistNearTpState(updated);
  654:         if (evaluation.transition()) {
  655:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback Near-TP: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, code={}, state={}, price={}, givebackPct={}, bearish1mStreak={}, detail={}",
  656:                     runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), evaluation.code(), updated.nearTpState(),
  657:                     signal.getLatestPrice(), evaluation.givebackPercent(), updated.nearTpBearishStreak(), evaluation.explanation());
  658:         }
  659:         if (!evaluation.harvestEligible()) return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.ZERO);
  660: 
  661:         BigDecimal soldQty = updated.quantity().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC);
  662:             ReplayMinimumExecutionPolicy.Evaluation minimumCheck =
  663:                     replayMinimumExecutionPolicy.evaluate(profile().minimumExecutableNotionalUsdt(), soldQty, signal.getLatestPrice());
  664:         if (!minimumCheck.executable()) {
  665:             updated = updated.withNearTp(new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
  666:                     NearTpState.NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED, updated.nearTpBestPrice(),
  667:                     0, updated.nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), false));
  668:             persistNearTpState(updated);
  669:             log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback NEAR_TP_HARVEST_SKIPPED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, reason={}, requestedQty={}, requestedNotional={}, binanceMinimum={}; existing position management continues",
  670:                     runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), minimumCheck.code(), soldQty,
  671:                     minimumCheck.requestedNotional(), minimumCheck.minimumNotional());
  672:             return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.ZERO);
  673:         }
  674:         BigDecimal proceeds = soldQty.multiply(signal.getLatestPrice(), MC);
  675:         BigDecimal soldCost = updated.entryPrice().multiply(soldQty, MC);
  676:         BigDecimal pnl = proceeds.subtract(soldCost, MC);
  677:         BigDecimal pnlPct = soldCost.signum() == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO : pnl.divide(soldCost, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
  678:                 .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
  679:         updated = updated.withPartialHarvest(soldQty, soldCost, pnl);
  680:         persistNearTpPartialHarvestAtSignal(runId, signal, updated, soldQty, proceeds, pnl, pnlPct, evaluation.explanation());
  681:         log.info("FIX-11T Replay fallback NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED: runId={}, positionId={}, symbol={}, soldQty={}, remainingQty={}, price={}, partialPnl={}",
  682:                 runId, updated.positionId(), signal.getSymbol(), soldQty, updated.quantity(), signal.getLatestPrice(), pnl);
  683:         return new FallbackNearTpEvaluation(updated, proceeds, pnl);
  684:     }

  686:     private ShadowPosition updateProfitLock(ShadowPosition p, TradeSignal s) {
  687:         if (s.getLatestPrice() == null || !priceAuthorityPolicy.canUseSignalPrice(s, p.entryTime())) return p;
  688:         ShadowPosition n = profitLockState(p, s.getLatestPrice());
  689:         if (!equalsNullable(p.highest(), n.highest()) || p.profitLockActive() != n.profitLockActive()
  690:                 || !equalsNullable(p.profitLockPrice(), n.profitLockPrice())
  691:                 || p.profitLockState() != n.profitLockState()
  692:                 || !java.util.Objects.equals(p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt(), n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt())) {
  693:             jdbcTemplate.update("UPDATE wallet_position_test SET highest_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_active=?, profit_lock_price_usdt=?, profit_lock_state=?, profit_lock_rebase_started_at=? WHERE id=?",
  694:                     n.highest(), n.profitLockActive(), n.profitLockPrice(), n.profitLockState().name(),
  695:                     n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt() == null ? null : Timestamp.from(n.profitLockRebaseStartedAt()), p.positionId());
  696:         }
  697:         return n;
  698:     }
  699: 
  700:     private ShadowPosition profitLockState(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal price) {
  701:         ReplayPolicyProfile settings = profile();
  702:         BigDecimal activation = settings.profitLockActivationPercent();
  703:         BigDecimal highest = p.highest() == null ? price : p.highest().max(price);
  704:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), highest);
  705: 
  706:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE
  707:                 && progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
  708:             // Replay parity with Production FIX-118: preserve the historical lock/legacy flag,
  709:             // but keep it non-executable until the new TP geometry earns activation again.
  710:             return p.withLock(highest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
  711:                     p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
  712:         }
  713: 
  714:         // FIX-118 parity: when REBASE earns activation, rebuild the lock from the current
  715:         // TP geometry instead of retaining the superseded pre-extension lock.
  716:         boolean freshGeometryActivation = p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE;
  717:         ProfitLockPolicy.State state = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(
  718:                 p.entryPrice(), p.takeProfit(), price, highest,
  719:                 freshGeometryActivation ? false : (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE || p.profitLockActive()),
  720:                 freshGeometryActivation ? null : p.profitLockPrice(),
  721:                 settings.dynamicProfitLockEnabled(), activation,
  722:                 settings.profitLockInitialPercent(), settings.profitLockTrailStepPercent());
  723:         ProfitLockState nextState = state.active() ? ProfitLockState.ACTIVE : ProfitLockState.INACTIVE;
  724:         return p.withLock(state.highestPrice(), state.active(), state.lockPrice(), nextState, null);
  725:     }

  727:     private ShadowPosition rebaseForExtendedTarget(ShadowPosition p, BigDecimal newTarget, BigDecimal extensionPrice, Instant at) {
  728:         if (p == null || newTarget == null) return p;
  729:         BigDecimal oldTarget = p.takeProfit();
  730:         BigDecimal oldLock = p.profitLockPrice();
  731:         BigDecimal activation = profile().profitLockActivationPercent();
  732:         BigDecimal extensionHighest = p.highest() == null ? p.entryPrice() : p.highest();
  733:         if (extensionPrice != null && extensionPrice.compareTo(extensionHighest) > 0) extensionHighest = extensionPrice;
  734:         ShadowPosition withExtensionHigh = p.withLock(extensionHighest, p.profitLockActive(), p.profitLockPrice(),
  735:                 p.profitLockState(), p.profitLockRebaseStartedAt());
  736:         BigDecimal progress = progressPercent(p.entryPrice(), newTarget, extensionHighest);
  737:         if (p.profitLockState() == ProfitLockState.ACTIVE) {
  738:             if (progress.compareTo(activation) < 0) {
  739:                 ShadowPosition rebasing = withExtensionHigh.withLock(extensionHighest, true, p.profitLockPrice(), ProfitLockState.TP_EXTENSION_REBASE,
  740:                         at == null ? Instant.now() : at);

===== 780-1025 =====
  780:     private BigDecimal progressPercent(BigDecimal entry, BigDecimal target, BigDecimal highest) {
  781:         if (entry == null || target == null || highest == null || target.compareTo(entry) <= 0) return BigDecimal.ZERO;
  782:         BigDecimal favorable = highest.subtract(entry);
  783:         if (favorable.signum() < 0) favorable = BigDecimal.ZERO;
  784:         return favorable.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
  785:                 .divide(target.subtract(entry, MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  786:     }

  815:         if (allocationPercent <= 0) return "NONE";
  816:         if (allocationPercent < 50) return "SCOUT_ENTRY";

  821:     private ShadowPosition addToPosition(long runId, ShadowPosition open, TradeSignal signal,
  822:                                          BigDecimal addedQty, BigDecimal addedCost, int addPercent) {
  823:         BigDecimal newQuantity = open.quantity().add(addedQty, MC);
  824:         BigDecimal newCost = open.cost().add(addedCost, MC);
  825:         BigDecimal newEntry = newCost.divide(newQuantity, 12, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  826:         BigDecimal newStop = open.stopLoss();
  827:         if (signal.getStopLoss() != null && (newStop == null || signal.getStopLoss().compareTo(newStop) > 0)) {
  828:             newStop = signal.getStopLoss();
  829:         }
  830:         BigDecimal newTakeProfit = open.takeProfit();
  831:         if (signal.getTakeProfit() != null && (newTakeProfit == null || signal.getTakeProfit().compareTo(newTakeProfit) > 0)) {
  832:             newTakeProfit = signal.getTakeProfit();
  833:         }
  834:         int newPercent = Math.min(100, open.positionPercent() + addPercent);
  835:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  836:                 UPDATE wallet_position_test
  837:                 SET entry_price=?, quantity=?, total_cost_usdt=?, position_percent=?,
  838:                     stop_loss_usdt=?, take_profit_usdt=?
  839:                 WHERE id=? AND test_run_id=?
  840:                 """, newEntry, newQuantity, newCost, newPercent, newStop, newTakeProfit,
  841:                 open.positionId(), runId);
  842:         ShadowPosition updated = open.withAdd(newEntry, newQuantity, newCost, newPercent, newStop, newTakeProfit);
  843:         persistNearTpState(updated);
  844:         return updated;
  845:     }

   66:     // FIX-087: heartbeat age alone cannot prove that a long replay worker has died.
   67:     // Some deterministic replay stages can legitimately run for more than the stale-heartbeat
   68:     // threshold without returning to updateRun(). Keep atomic in-JVM ownership so Resume cannot
   69:     // launch a second worker for the same durable run while the first worker is still executing.
   70:     private final Set<Long> activeRunIds = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
   71: 
   72:     // FIX-090: cooperative stop requests are tracked separately from active ownership. A Stop Test
   73:     // request never pretends the worker is gone; Delete Data stays blocked until runAsync reaches
   74:     // finally and removes the run from activeRunIds.
   75:     private final Set<Long> stopRequestedRunIds = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
   76: 
   77:     public boolean isActive(long runId) {
   78:         return activeRunIds.contains(runId);
   79:     }
   80: 
   81:     public boolean hasActiveRuns() {
   82:         return !activeRunIds.isEmpty();
   83:     }
   84: 
   85:     public boolean requestStop(long runId) {
   86:         if (!activeRunIds.contains(runId)) return false;
   87:         stopRequestedRunIds.add(runId);
   88:         return true;
   89:     }
   90: 
   91:     public boolean isStopRequested(long runId) {
   92:         return stopRequestedRunIds.contains(runId);
   93:     }
   94: 
   95:     private void checkStopRequested(long runId) {
   96:         if (stopRequestedRunIds.contains(runId)) throw new ReplayCancellationException(runId);
   97:     }

  450:             jdbcTemplate.update("""
  451:                     UPDATE analysis_test_run
  452:                     SET timing_load_historical_ns=?, timing_verify_event_resolution_ns=?,
  453:                         timing_build_replay_dataset_ns=?, timing_generate_fresh_signals_ns=?,
  454:                         timing_shadow_execution_ns=?, timing_parity_comparison_ns=?, timing_total_ns=?
  455:                     WHERE id=?
  456:                     """, loadHistoricalDataNs, verifyEventResolutionNs, buildReplayDatasetNs,
  457:                     generateFreshSignalsNs, shadowExecutionNs, parityComparisonNs, replayTotalNs, runId);
  458:         } catch (Exception timingPersistenceFailure) {
  459:             log.error("FIX-11J: unable to persist Replay timing diagnostics for run {}",
  460:                     runId, timingPersistenceFailure);
  461:         }
  462:     }
  463: 
  464:     /**
  465:      * FIX-11H: loads one immutable replay dataset. The prefix comes from the exact existing
  466:      * closed/as-of query, so missing candle gaps cannot shorten history. The forward segment
  467:      * explicitly requires closed=true. No Production caller reaches this method.
  468:      */
  469:     private ReplayDataset loadDataset(String symbol, String btcSymbol, Instant start, Instant end) {
  470:         Map<ReplayDataset.CandleKey, List<Candle>> candleMap = new HashMap<>();
  471:         Set<String> symbols = new LinkedHashSet<>(List.of(symbol, btcSymbol));
  472:         int historyLimit = technicalIndicatorService.regressionHistoryLimit();
  473:         for (String sym : symbols) {
  474:             for (String interval : List.of("1m", "5m", "1h")) {
  475:                 List<Candle> prefix = new java.util.ArrayList<>(candleRepository.findClosedCandlesAtOrBefore(
  476:                         sym, interval, start, PageRequest.of(0, historyLimit)));
  477:                 java.util.Collections.reverse(prefix);
  478:                 List<Candle> forward = candleRepository
  479:                         .findBySymbolAndIntervalCodeAndClosedTrueAndOpenTimeBetweenOrderByOpenTimeAsc(
  480:                                 sym, interval, start, end);
  481:                 List<Candle> merged = new java.util.ArrayList<>(prefix.size() + forward.size());
  482:                 merged.addAll(prefix);
  483:                 Instant prefixEnd = prefix.isEmpty() ? Instant.EPOCH : prefix.get(prefix.size() - 1).getOpenTime();
  484:                 forward.stream().filter(c -> c.getOpenTime().isAfter(prefixEnd)).forEach(merged::add);
  485:                 candleMap.put(new ReplayDataset.CandleKey(sym, interval), merged);
  486:                 log.info("FIX-11H dataset candles: symbol={}, interval={}, prefix={}, forward={}, merged={}",
  487:                         sym, interval, prefix.size(), forward.size(), merged.size());
  488:             }
  489:         }
  490: 
  491:         Map<ReplayDataset.SignalKey, Long> lineage = new HashMap<>();
  492:         // FIX-11H / FIX-112D: lineage is candle identity, not signal persistence timing.
  493:         // Recovery/backfilled Production signals can be generated hours after their candle, so
  494:         // generatedAt MUST NOT define this preload window. Select and match lineage by the same
  495:         // exact candleOpenTime identity used by ReplayDataset.sourceSignalId().
  496:         for (TradeSignal signal : signalRepository.findBySymbolAndCandleOpenTimeBetweenOrderByCandleOpenTimeAsc(symbol, start, end)) {
  497:             ReplayDataset.SignalKey key = new ReplayDataset.SignalKey(
  498:                     signal.getSymbol(), signal.getInterval(), signal.getCandleOpenTime());
  499:             Long previous = lineage.putIfAbsent(key, signal.getId());
  500:             if (previous != null && !previous.equals(signal.getId())) {
  501:                 throw new IllegalStateException("Replay lineage invariant violated for " + key
  502:                         + ": signalIds=" + previous + "," + signal.getId());
  503:             }
  504:         }
  505:         log.info("FIX-11H dataset lineage: symbol={}, entries={}", symbol, lineage.size());
  506:         return new ReplayDataset(candleMap, lineage);
  507:     }
  508: 
  509:     private List<Candle> candles(String symbol, String interval, Instant start, Instant end) {
  510:         return candleRepository.findBySymbolAndIntervalCodeAndOpenTimeBetweenOrderByOpenTimeAsc(
  511:                 symbol, interval, start, end);
  512:     }
  513: 
  514:     private int verifyEventResolution(long runId, String symbol, String interval, List<Candle> candles,
  515:                                       int progressStart, int progressEnd) {
  516:         int resolved = 0;
  517:         int size = candles.size();
  518:         for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
  519:             checkStopRequested(runId);
  520:             Candle candle = candles.get(i);
  521:             List<Candle> latestAtEvent = candleRepository.findClosedCandlesAtOrBefore(
  522:                     symbol, interval, candle.getOpenTime(), PageRequest.of(0, 1));
  523:             if (!latestAtEvent.isEmpty() && candle.getOpenTime().equals(latestAtEvent.get(0).getOpenTime())) {
  524:                 resolved++;
  525:             }
  526:             if (i % 25 == 0 && size > 0) {
  527:                 int p = progressStart + (int) Math.round((progressEnd - progressStart) * (i / (double) size));
  528:                 updateRun(runId, "RUNNING", p,
  529:                         "Replaying " + interval + " candle " + (i + 1) + "/" + size, null);
  530:             }
  531:         }
  532:         return resolved;
  533:     }
  534: 
  535:     private FreshReplayStats generateFreshSignals(
  536:             long runId,
  537:             String symbol,
  538:             Instant executionStart,
  539:             Instant executionEnd,
  540:             List<Candle> oneMinuteCandles,
  541:             List<Candle> fiveMinuteCandles,
  542:             List<Candle> oneHourCandles,
  543:             String btcSymbol,
  544:             List<Candle> btcOneMinuteCandles,
  545:             List<Candle> btcFiveMinuteCandles,
  546:             List<Candle> btcOneHourCandles,
  547:             ReplayDataSource dataSource,
  548:             ReplayDataset replayDataset
  549:     ) {
  550:         List<ReplayCandle> timeline = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  551:         oneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1m", c, true)));
  552:         fiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "5m", c, true)));
  553:         oneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1h", c, true)));
  554:         btcOneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1m", c, false)));
  555:         btcFiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "5m", c, false)));
  556:         btcOneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1h", c, false)));
  557:         timeline.sort(java.util.Comparator
  558:                 .comparing((ReplayCandle rc) -> rc.candle().getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(rc.interval())))
  559:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> intervalOrder(rc.interval()))
  560:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> rc.primary() ? 1 : 0));
  561: 
  562:         int oneMinuteSignals = 0, fiveMinuteSignals = 0, oneHourSignals = 0;
  563:         int oneMinuteBuys = 0, fiveMinuteBuys = 0, oneHourBuys = 0;
  564:         int buys = 0, watches = 0, sells = 0, strongSells = 0, errors = 0;
  565:         java.util.List<TradeSignal> generatedSignals = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  566: 
  567:         // FIX-11L: Replay-only deep profiling for the Generate fresh signals stage.
  568:         // These monotonic timers observe existing calls only; they do not alter inputs,
  569:         // call ordering, persistence, thresholds, or any Production trading behavior.
  570:         ReplayFreshSignalProfiler profiler = new ReplayFreshSignalProfiler(runId, dataSource);
  571:         // FIX-11M: Enable aggregate timing only for this Replay worker thread.
  572:         // The shared AnalysisService decision path is unchanged; this is observation-only.
  573:         analysisService.beginReplayAnalysisProfiling(runId);
  574:         try (ExecutionReplayScope.Scope ignored = replayScope.open(runId, List.of(), o -> {})) {
  575:         // FIX-043 Replay parity: fresh Replay has always generated technical snapshots/signals
  576:         // chronologically for EVERY closed candle in the timeline. Production now restores the
  577:         // same no-gap contract with asynchronous close-event processing plus chronological recovery.
  578:         // Do not "optimize" Replay by sampling every Nth candle or by copying the production recovery
  579:         // scheduler cadence; that would recreate the exact 1m->~5m blind-gap incident FIX-043 fixes.
  580:         for (int index = 0; index < timeline.size(); index++) {
  581:             checkStopRequested(runId);
  582:             ReplayCandle replay = timeline.get(index);
  583:             Candle candle = replay.candle();
  584:             Instant evaluationTime = candle.getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(replay.interval()));
  585:             boolean inRequestedWindow = !evaluationTime.isBefore(executionStart) && !evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd);
  586:             try {
  587:                 long operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  588:                 java.util.Optional<IndicatorSnapshot> snapshot;
  589:                 try {
  590:                     snapshot = dataSource == ReplayDataSource.DATASET
  591:                             ? technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
  592:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime(), replayDataset)
  593:                             : technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
  594:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime());
  595:                 } finally {
  596:                     profiler.recordSnapshot(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  597:                 }
  598:                 if (snapshot.isEmpty()) {
  599:                     if (inRequestedWindow) {
  600:                         errors++;
  601:                         saveGenerationError(runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle,
  602:                                 "Not enough historical candles to calculate the technical snapshot");
  603:                     }
  604:                     continue;
  605:                 }
  606: 
  607:                 // Do not generate a signal whose candle would only have closed after the
  608:                 // requested test end. Warm-up rows before executionStart are intentionally
  609:                 // generated for as-of context, but are not counted or displayed as test output.
  610:                 if (evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd)) continue;
  611: 
  612:                 replayScope.reference(evaluationTime);
  613:                 operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  614:                 TradeSignal generated;
  615:                 try {
  616:                     generated = analysisService.analyzeForRegression(snapshot.get(), evaluationTime);
  617:                 } finally {
  618:                     profiler.recordAnalysis(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  619:                 }
  620:                 replayScope.appendSignal(generated);
  621:                 SignalDecision decision = generated.getDecision();
  622:                 if (replay.primary()) generatedSignals.add(generated);
  623: 
  624:                 if (replay.primary() && inRequestedWindow) {
  625:                     if ("1m".equals(replay.interval())) { oneMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneMinuteBuys++; }
  626:                     else if ("5m".equals(replay.interval())) { fiveMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) fiveMinuteBuys++; }
  627:                     else if ("1h".equals(replay.interval())) { oneHourSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneHourBuys++; }
  628: 
  629:                     if (decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY) buys++;
  630:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.WATCH) watches++;
  631:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.SELL) sells++;
  632:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL) strongSells++;
  633: 
  634:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  635:                     try {
  636:                         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  637:                             INSERT INTO analysis_test_signal
  638:                                 (test_run_id, source_signal_id, replay_generated, symbol, interval_code, candle_open_time,
  639:                                  generated_at, latest_price, original_decision, final_decision,
  640:                                  execution_effective_decision, total_score, confidence_score, raw_confidence_score,
  641:                                  effective_confidence_score, primary_blocking_stage, detected_regime, candidate_regime,
  642:                                  confirmed_regime, regime_candidate_count, entry_authority, entry_authority_max_position_percent,
  643:                                  trend_score, volume_score, momentum_score, decision_authority_corrected, generation_error)
  644:                             VALUES (?, NULL, 1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, NULL)
  645:                             """,
  646:                             runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), Timestamp.from(candle.getOpenTime()),
  647:                             Timestamp.from(evaluationTime), generated.getLatestPrice(),
  648:                             generated.getOriginalDecision() == null ? null : generated.getOriginalDecision().name(),
  649:                             decision == null ? null : decision.name(),
  650:                             decision == null ? null : decision.name(),
  651:                             generated.getTotalScore(), generated.getConfidenceScore(), generated.getRawConfidenceScore(),
  652:                             generated.getEffectiveConfidenceScore(), generated.getPrimaryBlockingStage(),
  653:                             generated.getDetectedRegime() == null ? null : generated.getDetectedRegime().name(),
  654:                             generated.getCandidateRegime() == null ? null : generated.getCandidateRegime().name(),
  655:                             generated.getConfirmedRegime() == null ? null : generated.getConfirmedRegime().name(),
  656:                             generated.getRegimeCandidateCount(), generated.getEntryAuthority(),
  657:                             generated.getEntryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent(), generated.getTrendScore(),
  658:                             generated.getVolumeScore(), generated.getMomentumScore());
  659:                     } finally {
  660:                         profiler.recordAnalysisTestSignalPersistence(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  661:                     }
  662: 
  663:                     // FIX-069: Persist the exact production TradeSignal shape as replay output.
  664:                     // analysis_test_signal remains for backward-compatible diagnostics, while
  665:                     // trade_signal_test is the canonical parity table used for field-by-field comparison.
  666:                     // FIX-112D: Replay lineage uses exact market-candle identity, never
  667:                     // generated_at or nearest-time matching. A legitimate Replay-only
  668:                     // signal remains NULL. This metadata lookup cannot alter Production.
  669:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  670:                     Long sourceSignalId;
  671:                     try {
  672:                         sourceSignalId = dataSource == ReplayDataSource.DATASET
  673:                                 ? replayDataset.sourceSignalId(
  674:                                         generated.getSymbol(), generated.getInterval(), generated.getCandleOpenTime())
  675:                                 : signalRepository.findBySymbolAndIntervalAndCandleOpenTime(
  676:                                         generated.getSymbol(), generated.getInterval(), generated.getCandleOpenTime())
  677:                                         .map(TradeSignal::getId).orElse(null);
  678:                     } finally {
  679:                         profiler.recordLineageLookup(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  680:                     }
  681:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  682:                     try {
  683:                         persistTradeSignalTest(runId, generated, sourceSignalId, null);
  684:                     } finally {
  685:                         profiler.recordTradeSignalTestPersistence(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
  686:                     }
  687:                 }
  688:             } catch (ReplayCancellationException stop) {
  689:                 throw stop;
  690:             } catch (Exception exception) {
  691:                 if (replay.primary() && inRequestedWindow) {
  692:                     errors++;
  693:                     saveGenerationError(runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle, errorDetail(exception, 900));
  694:                 }
  695:                 log.warn("Regression fresh-signal generation failed: run={}, symbol={}, interval={}, candle={}",
  696:                         runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime(), exception);
  697:             }
  698: 
  699:             if (index % 10 == 0 && !timeline.isEmpty()) {
  700:                 int progress = 43 + (int) Math.round(30d * index / timeline.size());
  701:                 long progressStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
  702:                 try {
  703:                     updateRun(runId, "RUNNING", Math.min(73, progress),
  704:                             "Generating fresh signal " + (index + 1) + "/" + timeline.size(), null);
  705:                 } finally {
  706:                     profiler.recordProgressUpdate(System.nanoTime() - progressStartedNs);
  707:                 }
  708:             }
  709:         }
  710: 
  711:         } finally {
  712:             // FIX-11M must never turn a valid Replay into ERROR if diagnostic summary logging fails.
  713:             try {
  714:                 analysisService.finishReplayAnalysisProfiling(runId);
  715:             } catch (Exception profilingException) {
  716:                 log.warn("FIX11M_REPLAY_ANALYSIS_PROFILE_ERROR run={} message={} productionMutation=false replayDecisionMutation=false",
  717:                         runId, profilingException.getMessage());
  718:             }
  719:             profiler.logSummary(log, timeline.size());
  720:         }
  721:         return new FreshReplayStats(oneMinuteSignals, oneMinuteBuys, fiveMinuteSignals, fiveMinuteBuys,
  722:                 oneHourSignals, oneHourBuys, buys, watches, sells, strongSells, errors, generatedSignals);
  723:     }
  724: 
  725:     private void saveGenerationError(long runId, String symbol, String interval, Candle candle, String error) {
  726:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  727:                 INSERT INTO analysis_test_signal
  728:                     (test_run_id, source_signal_id, replay_generated, symbol, interval_code, candle_open_time,
  729:                      generated_at, latest_price, decision_authority_corrected, generation_error)
  730:                 VALUES (?, NULL, 1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?)
  731:                 """, runId, symbol, interval, Timestamp.from(candle.getOpenTime()),
  732:                 Timestamp.from(candle.getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(interval))),
  733:                 candle.getClosePrice(), error);
  734:     }
  735: 
  736:     /**
  737:      * FIX-069: write every field mapped by the TradeSignal JPA entity into trade_signal_test.
  738:      * Reflection is intentional here: whenever production TradeSignal gains another @Column,
  739:      * replay inherits it automatically instead of drifting behind a hand-maintained test schema.
  740:      */
  741:     private void persistTradeSignalTest(long runId, TradeSignal signal, Long sourceSignalId, String generationError) {
  742:         try {
  743:             java.util.List<String> columns = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  744:             java.util.List<Object> values = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
  745:             columns.add("test_run_id"); values.add(runId);
  746:             // FIX-112D / Replay=Production audit lineage: this ID points only to the
  747:             // exact Production signal for the same symbol + interval + candle_open_time.
  748:             // It is additive Replay metadata and is never an execution authority.
  749:             columns.add("source_signal_id"); values.add(sourceSignalId);
  750:             columns.add("replay_generated"); values.add(1);
  751:             columns.add("generation_error"); values.add(generationError);
  752: 
  753:             for (Field field : TradeSignal.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
  754:                 if ("id".equals(field.getName()) || "createdAt".equals(field.getName())) continue;
  755:                 Column column = field.getAnnotation(Column.class);
  756:                 if (column == null) continue;
  757:                 field.setAccessible(true);
  758:                 Object value = field.get(signal);
  759:                 if (value instanceof Enum<?> e) value = e.name();
  760:                 if (value instanceof Instant instant) value = Timestamp.from(instant);
  761:                 String columnName = column.name();
  762:                 if (columnName == null || columnName.isBlank()) columnName = snakeCase(field.getName());
  763:                 columns.add(columnName);
  764:                 values.add(value);
  765:             }
  766: 
  767:             String placeholders = String.join(",", java.util.Collections.nCopies(values.size(), "?"));
  768:             jdbcTemplate.update("INSERT INTO trade_signal_test (" + String.join(",", columns) + ") VALUES (" + placeholders + ")", values.toArray());
  769:         } catch (Exception e) {
  770:             throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to persist production-shaped replay TradeSignal", e);
  771:         }
  772:     }
  773: 
  774:     private String snakeCase(String value) {
  775:         return value.replaceAll("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "$1_$2").toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
  776:     }
  777: 
  778:     private long intervalSeconds(String interval) {
  779:         return switch (interval) {
  780:             case "1m" -> 60L;
  781:             case "5m" -> 300L;
  782:             case "1h" -> 3600L;
  783:             default -> 60L;
  784:         };
  785:     }
  786: 
  787:     private int intervalOrder(String interval) {
  788:         return switch (interval) {
  789:             case "1h" -> 0;
  790:             case "5m" -> 1;
  791:             default -> 2;
  792:         };
  793:     }
  794: 
  795:     private boolean isBuy(SignalDecision decision) {
  796:         return decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY;
  797:     }
  798: 
  799:     /**
  800:      * FIX-11L Replay-only profiler for the fresh-signal generation loop. It deliberately
  801:      * aggregates timings in memory and emits one summary log after the stage; there are no
  802:      * per-signal log writes and no Production/shared-analysis branches.
  803:      */
  804:     private static final class ReplayFreshSignalProfiler {
  805:         private final long runId;
  806:         private final ReplayDataSource dataSource;
  807:         private final long startedNs = System.nanoTime();
  808:         private long snapshotNs;
  809:         private long analysisNs;
  810:         private long analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs;
  811:         private long lineageLookupNs;
  812:         private long tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs;
  813:         private long progressUpdateNs;
  814:         private long snapshotCalls;
  815:         private long analysisCalls;
  816:         private long analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls;
  817:         private long lineageLookupCalls;
  818:         private long tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls;
  819:         private long progressUpdateCalls;
  820:         private long maxSnapshotNs;
  821:         private long maxAnalysisNs;
  822: 
  823:         private ReplayFreshSignalProfiler(long runId, ReplayDataSource dataSource) {
  824:             this.runId = runId;
  825:             this.dataSource = dataSource;
  826:         }
  827: 
  828:         private void recordSnapshot(long elapsedNs) {
  829:             snapshotNs += elapsedNs;
  830:             snapshotCalls++;
  831:             maxSnapshotNs = Math.max(maxSnapshotNs, elapsedNs);
  832:         }
  833: 
  834:         private void recordAnalysis(long elapsedNs) {
  835:             analysisNs += elapsedNs;
  836:             analysisCalls++;
  837:             maxAnalysisNs = Math.max(maxAnalysisNs, elapsedNs);
  838:         }
  839: 
  840:         private void recordAnalysisTestSignalPersistence(long elapsedNs) {
  841:             analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs += elapsedNs;
  842:             analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls++;
  843:         }
  844: 
  845:         private void recordLineageLookup(long elapsedNs) {
  846:             lineageLookupNs += elapsedNs;
  847:             lineageLookupCalls++;
  848:         }
  849: 
  850:         private void recordTradeSignalTestPersistence(long elapsedNs) {
  851:             tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs += elapsedNs;
  852:             tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls++;
  853:         }
  854: 
  855:         private void recordProgressUpdate(long elapsedNs) {
  856:             progressUpdateNs += elapsedNs;
  857:             progressUpdateCalls++;
  858:         }
  859: 
  860:         private void logSummary(org.slf4j.Logger logger, int timelineSize) {
  861:             long totalNs = System.nanoTime() - startedNs;
  862:             long measuredNs = snapshotNs + analysisNs + analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs
  863:                     + lineageLookupNs + tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs + progressUpdateNs;
  864:             long otherNs = Math.max(0L, totalNs - measuredNs);
  865:             logger.info(
  866:                     "FIX11L_REPLAY_SIGNAL_PROFILE run={} dataSource={} timeline={} totalMs={} "
  867:                             + "snapshotMs={} snapshotCalls={} snapshotAvgMs={} snapshotMaxMs={} "
  868:                             + "analysisMs={} analysisCalls={} analysisAvgMs={} analysisMaxMs={} "
  869:                             + "analysisTestSignalPersistMs={} analysisTestSignalPersistCalls={} "
  870:                             + "lineageMs={} lineageCalls={} tradeSignalTestPersistMs={} tradeSignalTestPersistCalls={} "
  871:                             + "progressMs={} progressCalls={} otherMs={} productionMutation=false replayDecisionMutation=false",
  872:                     runId, dataSource, timelineSize, millis(totalNs),
  873:                     millis(snapshotNs), snapshotCalls, averageMillis(snapshotNs, snapshotCalls), millis(maxSnapshotNs),
  874:                     millis(analysisNs), analysisCalls, averageMillis(analysisNs, analysisCalls), millis(maxAnalysisNs),
  875:                     millis(analysisTestSignalPersistenceNs), analysisTestSignalPersistenceCalls,
  876:                     millis(lineageLookupNs), lineageLookupCalls, millis(tradeSignalTestPersistenceNs),
  877:                     tradeSignalTestPersistenceCalls, millis(progressUpdateNs), progressUpdateCalls, millis(otherNs));
  878:         }
  879: 
  880:         private static String millis(long ns) {
  881:             return String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", ns / 1_000_000.0d);
  882:         }
  883: 
  884:         private static String averageMillis(long ns, long calls) {
  885:             return calls == 0L ? "0.000"
  886:                     : String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", (ns / 1_000_000.0d) / calls);
  887:         }
  888:     }
  889: 
  890:     private record ReplayCandle(String symbol, String interval, Candle candle, boolean primary) {}
  891: 
  892:     private record FreshReplayStats(
  893:             int oneMinuteSignals, int oneMinuteBuys,
  894:             int fiveMinuteSignals, int fiveMinuteBuys,

  939:     private Throwable rootCause(Throwable exception) {
  940:         if (exception == null) return null;
  941:         Throwable root = exception;
  942:         while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
  943:             root = root.getCause();
  944:         }
  945:         return root;
  946:     }

  948:     private String rootCauseDetail(Throwable root, int max) {
  949:         if (root == null) return "Unknown root cause";
  950:         String message = root.getMessage();
  951:         String detail = root.getClass().getName() + (message == null || message.isBlank() ? "" : ": " + message);
  952:         return abbreviate(detail, max);
  953:     }

  956:         if (exception == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
  957:         StringWriter buffer = new StringWriter();
  958:         try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(buffer)) {
  959:             exception.printStackTrace(writer);
  960:         }
  961:         return buffer.toString();
  962:     }

  964:     private Instant toInstant(Object value) {
  965:         if (value instanceof Timestamp timestamp) return timestamp.toInstant();
  966:         if (value instanceof Instant instant) return instant;
  967:         if (value instanceof LocalDateTime localDateTime) return localDateTime.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC);
  968:         throw new IllegalStateException("Unsupported regression timestamp value: " + value);
  969:     }
  970:

  972:     private String errorDetail(Throwable exception, int max) {
  973:         if (exception == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
  974:         Throwable root = exception;
  975:         while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
  976:             root = root.getCause();
  977:         }
  978:         StringBuilder detail = new StringBuilder()
  979:                 .append(exception.getClass().getName())
  980:                 .append(": ")
  981:                 .append(exception.getMessage() == null ? exception.toString() : exception.getMessage());
  982:         if (root != exception) {
  983:             detail.append(" | Root cause: ")
  984:                     .append(root.getClass().getName())
  985:                     .append(": ")
  986:                     .append(root.getMessage() == null ? root.toString() : root.getMessage());
  987:         }
  988:         return abbreviate(detail.toString(), max);
  989:     }
  990: 
  991:     private String abbreviate(String value, int max) {
  992:         if (value == null) return "Unknown regression test error";
  993:         return value.length() <= max ? value : value.substring(0, max);
  994:     }

   25: /**
   26:  * FIX-11Q �?" Replay-only one-candle continuation grace experiment.
   27:  *
   28:  * The Production-parity Shadow position always remains authoritative. This observer starts a
   29:  * separate counterfactual position only after the existing PositionContinuationPolicy has already
   30:  * returned FAIL at a reached take-profit checkpoint. Existing continuation PASS paths therefore
   31:  * remain untouched and continue to extend take profit exactly as before.
   32:  *
   33:  * The counterfactual holds through one specific NEUTRAL 1m candle without moving TP. The grace is
   34:  * tied to that candle (not one live-price tick), may be consumed only once per position lifetime,
   35:  * and normal shared continuation/exit policies resume after a new 1m candle arrives.
   36:  */
   37: @Slf4j
   38: @Service
   39: @RequiredArgsConstructor
   40: public class OneCandleContinuationGraceReplayObserver {
   41:     private static final MathContext MC = MathContext.DECIMAL64;
   42: 
   43:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
   44:     private final PositionContinuationPolicy continuationPolicy;
   45:     private final PositionExitPolicy exitPolicy;
   46:     private final ProfitLockPolicy profitLockPolicy;
   47:     private final TradeExecutionValidationService executionValidationService;
   48:     private final WalletSettingsRepository walletSettingsRepository;

   51:     private final Map<Long, java.util.Set<Long>> consumedByRun = new HashMap<>();

   53:     public synchronized void startRun(long runId, String symbol) {
   54:         activeByRun.remove(runId);
   55:         consumedByRun.put(runId, new java.util.HashSet<>());
   56:         log.info("FIX11Q_GRACE_START runId={} symbol={} mode=REPLAY_COUNTERFACTUAL productionMutation=false baselineReplayMutation=false", runId, symbol);
   57:     }

   59:     public synchronized void observeBaselineTakeProfitFailure(
   60:             long runId, String symbol, long positionId, Instant observedAt, BigDecimal price,
   61:             Instant entryTime, BigDecimal entryPrice, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal cost,
   62:             BigDecimal stopLoss, BigDecimal takeProfit, BigDecimal highest,
   63:             boolean profitLockActive, BigDecimal profitLockPrice,
   64:             int entryScore, int entryConfidence, int entryTrend, int entryStructure,
   65:             int entryMomentum, int entryVolume,
   66:             TradeSignal current1m, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour,
   67:             String baselineExplanation) {
   68: 
   69:         if (activeByRun.containsKey(runId) || consumedByRun.getOrDefault(runId, java.util.Set.of()).contains(positionId)) return;
   70:         if (!eligible(current1m, fiveMinute, oneHour, entryMomentum)) return;
   71: 
   72:         Instant candleIdentity = candleIdentity(current1m);
   73:         if (candleIdentity == null) return;
   74:         BigDecimal baselinePnl = price.multiply(quantity, MC).subtract(cost, MC);
   75:         BigDecimal baselinePnlPct = percentage(entryPrice, price);
   76:         BigDecimal safeHighest = highest == null ? price : highest.max(price);
   77: 
   78:         Variant v = new Variant(positionId, symbol, entryTime, entryPrice, quantity, cost, stopLoss,
   79:                 takeProfit, safeHighest, profitLockActive, profitLockPrice,
   80:                 entryScore, entryConfidence, entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
   81:                 candleIdentity, current1m == null ? null : current1m.getId(), observedAt, price,
   82:                 baselinePnl, baselinePnlPct, price, price, current1m, fiveMinute, oneHour);
   83:         activeByRun.put(runId, v);
   84:         consumedByRun.computeIfAbsent(runId, k -> new java.util.HashSet<>()).add(positionId);
   85: 
   86:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
   87:                 INSERT INTO one_candle_continuation_grace_test
   88:                 (test_run_id,position_test_id,symbol,grace_at,grace_1m_signal_id,grace_candle_time,
   89:                  price_at_grace,entry_price,take_profit_before_grace,take_profit_after_grace,
   90:                  current_1m_decision,five_minute_decision,one_hour_decision,trend_score,trend_floor,
   91:                  momentum_score,momentum_floor,baseline_action,baseline_exit_price,baseline_pnl_usdt,
   92:                  baseline_pnl_percent,status,baseline_explanation)
   93:                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
   94:                 """, runId, positionId, symbol, Timestamp.from(observedAt), v.graceSignalId(), Timestamp.from(candleIdentity),
   95:                 price, entryPrice, takeProfit, takeProfit, name(current1m.getDecision()), name(fiveMinute.getDecision()),
   96:                 name(oneHour.getDecision()), current1m.getTrendScore(), trendFloor(entryTrend),
   97:                 current1m.getMomentumScore(), momentumFloor(entryMomentum), "TAKE_PROFIT_EXIT", price,
   98:                 baselinePnl, baselinePnlPct, "ACTIVE", baselineExplanation);
   99: 
  100:         log.info("FIX11Q_GRACE_ACTIVATED runId={} positionId={} symbol={} observedAt={} candle={} price={} tp={} current={} five={} one={} trend={}/{} momentum={}/{} action=HOLD_TARGET_UNCHANGED",
  101:                 runId, positionId, symbol, observedAt, candleIdentity, price, takeProfit,
  102:                 name(current1m.getDecision()), name(fiveMinute.getDecision()), name(oneHour.getDecision()),
  103:                 current1m.getTrendScore(), trendFloor(entryTrend), current1m.getMomentumScore(), momentumFloor(entryMomentum));
  104:     }

  106:     public synchronized void onSignal(long runId, TradeSignal signal, TradeSignal latest1m, TradeSignal latest5m, TradeSignal latest1h) {
  107:         Variant v = activeByRun.get(runId);
  108:         if (v == null || signal == null) return;
  109:         if ("1m".equals(signal.getInterval()) && v.next1mDecision() == null && !sameGraceCandle(v, signal)) {
  110:             v = v.withNext1m(name(signal.getDecision()));
  111:         }
  112:         if ("5m".equals(signal.getInterval()) && v.next5mDecision() == null && signal.getGeneratedAt() != null && signal.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(v.graceAt())) {
  113:             v = v.withNext5m(name(signal.getDecision()));
  114:         }
  115:         if ("1h".equals(signal.getInterval()) && v.next1hDecision() == null && signal.getGeneratedAt() != null && signal.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(v.graceAt())) {
  116:             v = v.withNext1h(name(signal.getDecision()));
  117:         }
  118:         activeByRun.put(runId, v.withContext(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h));
  119:     }
  120: 
  121:     public synchronized void onPrice(long runId, String symbol, MarketPriceEventService.PriceEvent event,
  122:                                      TradeSignal latest1m, TradeSignal latest5m, TradeSignal latest1h) {
  123:         Variant v = activeByRun.get(runId);
  124:         if (v == null || event == null || event.price() == null || !v.symbol().equals(symbol)) return;
  125:         if (!event.observedAt().isAfter(v.graceAt())) return;
  126: 
  127:         BigDecimal price = event.price();
  128:         v = v.withContext(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h).withPath(price);
  129:         boolean sameGraceCandle = sameGraceCandle(v, latest1m);
  130: 
  131:         // Hard protection remains active even during grace; FIX-11Q suppresses only the baseline
  132:         // TAKE_PROFIT exit caused by transient continuation failure.
  133:         if (v.stopLoss() != null && price.compareTo(v.stopLoss()) <= 0) {
  134:             close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, "STOP_LOSS", "Stop loss reached during/after grace."); return;
  135:         }
  136: 
  137:         v = updateProfitLock(v, price);
  138:         if (v.profitLockActive() && v.profitLockPrice() != null && price.compareTo(v.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
  139:             BigDecimal hardFloor = v.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005), MC);
  140:             if (price.compareTo(hardFloor) < 0) {
  141:                 close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", "Profit-lock hard floor breached in FIX-11Q counterfactual."); return;
  142:             }
  143:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lock = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h);
  144:             if (lock.exit()) { close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, lock.code(), lock.explanation()); return; }
  145:         }
  146: 
  147:         if (v.takeProfit() != null && price.compareTo(v.takeProfit()) >= 0) {
  148:             if (sameGraceCandle) {
  149:                 activeByRun.put(runId, v); // hold entire candle; target intentionally unchanged
  150:                 return;
  151:             }
  152:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(
  153:                     latest1m, latest5m, latest1h, v.entryTrend(), v.entryStructure(), v.entryMomentum(), v.entryVolume(),
  154:                     v.entryConfidence(), v.entryScore());
  155:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
  156:                 BigDecimal distance = v.takeProfit().subtract(v.entryPrice());
  157:                 BigDecimal newTarget = v.takeProfit().add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
  158:                 activeByRun.put(runId, v.withTakeProfit(newTarget));
  159:                 log.info("FIX11Q_VARIANT_TP_EXTENDED runId={} positionId={} oldTp={} newTp={} reason={}", runId, v.positionId(), v.takeProfit(), newTarget, continuation.explanation());
  160:                 return;
  161:             }
  162:             close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, "TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation()); return;
  163:         }
  164: 
  165:         if (!sameGraceCandle) {
  166:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation normal = exitPolicy.evaluateNormalExit(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h);
  167:             if (normal.exit()) { close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, normal.code(), normal.explanation()); return; }
  168:             if (latest1m != null && "1m".equals(latest1m.getInterval()) && bearish(latest1m.getDecision())) {
  169:                 TradeExecutionValidationService.ValidationResult validated = executionValidationService.validateSell(latest1m);
  170:                 if (validated.allowed()) { close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, validated.code(), validated.explanation()); return; }
  171:             }
  172:         }
  173:         activeByRun.put(runId, v);
  174:     }
  175: 
  176:     public synchronized void finishRun(long runId, String symbol, Instant endTime) {
  177:         Variant v = activeByRun.remove(runId);
  178:         if (v != null) {
  179:             BigDecimal pnl = v.lastPrice().multiply(v.quantity(), MC).subtract(v.cost(), MC);
  180:             updateRow(runId, v, endTime, v.lastPrice(), "OPEN_AT_WINDOW_END", pnl, percentage(v.entryPrice(), v.lastPrice()));
  181:         }
  182:         Integer count = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM one_candle_continuation_grace_test WHERE test_run_id=?", Integer.class, runId);
  183:         log.info("FIX11Q_GRACE_SUMMARY runId={} symbol={} candidates={} mode=REPLAY_COUNTERFACTUAL", runId, symbol, count == null ? 0 : count);
  184:         consumedByRun.remove(runId);
  185:     }
  186: 
  187:     private boolean eligible(TradeSignal one, TradeSignal five, TradeSignal hour, int entryMomentum) {
  188:         return one != null && five != null && hour != null
  189:                 && one.getDecision() == SignalDecision.NEUTRAL
  190:                 && bullish(hour.getDecision()) && !bearish(five.getDecision())
  191:                 && one.getMomentumScore() >= momentumFloor(entryMomentum);
  192:     }
  193: 
  194:     private Variant updateProfitLock(Variant v, BigDecimal price) {
  195:         WalletSettings s = walletSettingsRepository.findById(1L).orElseGet(() -> WalletSettings.builder()
  196:                 .id(1L).dynamicProfitLockEnabled(true).profitLockActivationPercent(BigDecimal.valueOf(70))
  197:                 .profitLockInitialPercent(BigDecimal.valueOf(40)).profitLockTrailStepPercent(BigDecimal.valueOf(10)).build());
  198:         ProfitLockPolicy.State st = profitLockPolicy.evaluate(v.entryPrice(), v.takeProfit(), price, v.highest(),
  199:                 v.profitLockActive(), v.profitLockPrice(), s.isDynamicProfitLockEnabled(),
  200:                 nvl(s.getProfitLockActivationPercent(), BigDecimal.valueOf(70)),
  201:                 nvl(s.getProfitLockInitialPercent(), BigDecimal.valueOf(40)),
  202:                 nvl(s.getProfitLockTrailStepPercent(), BigDecimal.valueOf(10)));
  203:         return v.withLock(st.highestPrice(), st.active(), st.lockPrice());
  204:     }

  206:     private void close(long runId, Variant v, Instant at, BigDecimal price, String reason, String explanation) {
  207:         BigDecimal pnl = price.multiply(v.quantity(), MC).subtract(v.cost(), MC);
  208:         updateRow(runId, v, at, price, reason, pnl, percentage(v.entryPrice(), price));
  209:         activeByRun.remove(runId);
  210:         log.info("FIX11Q_VARIANT_CLOSED runId={} positionId={} symbol={} at={} price={} reason={} baselinePnl={} variantPnl={} delta={}",
  211:                 runId, v.positionId(), v.symbol(), at, price, reason, v.baselinePnl(), pnl, pnl.subtract(v.baselinePnl(), MC));
  212:     }

  216:         jdbcTemplate.update("""

  221:                 WHERE test_run_id=? AND position_test_id=?
  222:                 """, v.next1mDecision(), v.next5mDecision(), v.next1hDecision(), Timestamp.from(at), price,
  223:                 reason, pnl, pnlPct, pnl.subtract(v.baselinePnl(), MC), percentage(v.priceAtGrace(), v.maxPrice()),
  224:                 percentage(v.priceAtGrace(), v.minPrice()), result, reason.equals("OPEN_AT_WINDOW_END") ? reason : "CLOSED",
  225:                 runId, v.positionId());

   16:  * <p>TradeSignal.latestPrice is immutable decision-time evidence and must never be
   17:  * treated as an execution fill. Production resolves the newest canonical Binance 1m
   18:  * live-price event recorded by FIX-052. Administration Replay resolves the newest
   19:  * replay price event already consumed by ExecutionReplayScope. This gives both paths
   20:  * one price authority while preserving the original signal snapshot for audit.</p>
   21:  */
   22: @Service
   23: @RequiredArgsConstructor
   24: public class ExecutionPriceAuthorityService {
   25:     private static final Duration MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE = Duration.ofSeconds(15);
   26:

   30:     public Optional<ExecutionPrice> resolve(String symbol, Instant referenceTime) {
   31:         // FIX-109 / Replay parity: wall-clock fallback is forbidden. Every caller must
   32:         // supply the evaluation clock explicitly so historical Replay can never silently
   33:         // compare an old market event with the machine clock used by Production today.
   34:         Instant reference = Objects.requireNonNull(referenceTime,
   35:                 "Execution price reference time is required");
   36: 
   37:         if (replayScope.active()) {
   38:             return replayScope.latestPrice()
   39:                     .filter(p -> symbol != null && symbol.equalsIgnoreCase(p.symbol()))
   40:                     .filter(p -> !p.observedAt().isAfter(reference))
   41:                     .filter(p -> !Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).isNegative())
   42:                     .filter(p -> Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).compareTo(MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE) <= 0)
   43:                     .map(p -> new ExecutionPrice(p.price(), p.observedAt(), "REPLAY_MARKET_PRICE_EVENT"));
   44:         }
   45: 
   46:         return marketPriceEventService.findLatestAtOrBefore(symbol, reference)
   47:                 .filter(p -> Duration.between(p.observedAt(), reference).compareTo(MAX_EXECUTION_PRICE_AGE) <= 0)
   48:                 .map(p -> new ExecutionPrice(p.price(), p.observedAt(), p.source()));
   49:     }

    2: 
    3: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    4: 
    5: import java.math.BigDecimal;
    6: import java.math.RoundingMode;
    7: 
    8: /**
    9:  * FIX-156: Replay-only mirror of the approved sizing arithmetic. It consumes a
   10:  * frozen profile and deliberately has no wallet repository dependency.
   11:  */
   12: @Component
   13: public final class ReplaySizingPolicy {
   14:     private static final BigDecimal ZERO = BigDecimal.ZERO;
   15:     private static final int SCALE = 12;
   16: 
   17:     public Plan plan(BigDecimal availableUsdt, BigDecimal minimumReserve, BigDecimal dailyTradeBudget,
   18:                      int requestedPositionPercent, int currentAllocatedPercent,
   19:                      boolean newPosition, int maximumNewPositions, int executedNewPositions,
   20:                      BigDecimal price) {
   21:         int requested = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, requestedPositionPercent));
   22:         int current = Math.max(0, currentAllocatedPercent);
   23:         int normalized = Math.min(requested, Math.max(0, 100 - current));
   24:         if (normalized <= 0) return Plan.reject("ALLOCATION_FULL");
   25:         if (newPosition && maximumNewPositions > 0 && executedNewPositions >= maximumNewPositions) {
   26:             return Plan.reject("DAILY_POSITION_LIMIT");
   27:         }
   28:         BigDecimal available = value(availableUsdt).subtract(value(minimumReserve)).max(ZERO);
   29:         BigDecimal spend = value(dailyTradeBudget).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(normalized))
   30:                 .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), SCALE, RoundingMode.DOWN);
   31:         if (spend.signum() <= 0) return Plan.reject("ZERO_BUDGET");
   32:         if (available.compareTo(spend) < 0) return Plan.reject("INSUFFICIENT_USDT_ABOVE_RESERVE");
   33:         if (price == null || price.signum() <= 0) return Plan.reject("INVALID_PRICE");
   34:         BigDecimal quantity = spend.divide(price, SCALE, RoundingMode.DOWN);
   35:         return quantity.signum() <= 0 ? Plan.reject("ZERO_QUANTITY")
   36:                 : new Plan(true, normalized, spend, quantity, "APPROVED");
   37:     }
   38: 
   39:     public BigDecimal initialDailyBudget(BigDecimal availableUsdt, BigDecimal minimumReserve,
   40:                                          BigDecimal baseTradeAmount, int maximumNewPositions) {
   41:         BigDecimal tradable = value(availableUsdt).subtract(value(minimumReserve)).max(ZERO);
   42:         if (tradable.signum() <= 0) return ZERO;
   43:         return maximumNewPositions == 0 ? value(baseTradeAmount).min(tradable)
   44:                 : tradable.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(maximumNewPositions), SCALE, RoundingMode.DOWN);
   45:     }
   46: 
   47:     private BigDecimal value(BigDecimal input) { return input == null ? ZERO : input; }
   48: 
   49:     public record Plan(boolean allowed, int normalizedPositionPercent, BigDecimal spend,
   50:                        BigDecimal quantity, String code) {
   51:         private static Plan reject(String code) { return new Plan(false, 0, ZERO, ZERO, code); }
   52:     }
   53: }

  780:     private BigDecimal progressPercent(BigDecimal entry, BigDecimal target, BigDecimal highest) {
  781:         if (entry == null || target == null || highest == null || target.compareTo(entry) <= 0) return BigDecimal.ZERO;
  782:         BigDecimal favorable = highest.subtract(entry);
  783:         if (favorable.signum() < 0) favorable = BigDecimal.ZERO;
  784:         return favorable.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
  785:                 .divide(target.subtract(entry, MC), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  786:     }

## FINDINGS

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — FIX-156 cannot be accepted as complete.** The exact RPR-0.9.12 design named by hash is absent; the repository’s canonical specification is still RPR-0.4 marked “NOT APPROVED — IMPLEMENTATION FORBIDDEN.” Exact registry reconciliation is therefore impossible.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — Replay still reaches the shared Production BUY validation path.** `ShadowProductionReplayService` calls `ExecutionIntelligenceService.evaluateBuy`; that calls `TradeExecutionValidationService.validateBuy`, which reads `WalletSettingsRepository`. This violates the Jean requirement for a Replay-local BUY path with no wallet-settings fallback.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — The SQL boundary is opt-in, not enforced.** Only the new profile and FIX-122 stores invoke `ReplayAccessPolicy`. The active worker, shadow lifecycle, and regression service issue direct JDBC operations. The policy cannot reject those operations.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — A shared-table write remains reachable.** With `shared-market.mode=LIVE`, every Replay worker opens `CandleInputAudit`, which inserts `shared_candle_input_audit`. Jean’s stated exception permits only specified `fix122_evaluation` operations.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — Profile lifecycle is unsafe and incomplete.** No main-source profile creator/insert caller was found, so normal new runs refuse at `require(runId)`. Worse, Delete Data resets `analysis_test_run` IDs but does not purge `replay_policy_profile`; a reused run ID can load a prior run’s frozen profile.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — Parity evidence is not implemented end-to-end.** The certificate, trace, output, fixture, and price-coverage tables have no application writer. “Exact” price mode is still set when the price-event list is merely non-empty, not after proving complete position-lifetime coverage.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — O-8 is still bypassable.** `ReplayFix122EvaluationStore` has the intended four statement shapes, but `StopLossEvidenceStore` still directly reads/writes `fix122_evaluation`; the Replay diagnostics controller uses that Production store directly.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — Required test evidence is absent.** No T156-09a test exists. The present policy tests test declared categories, not static reachability or interception of the actual Replay lifecycle. No Java 21 or disposable-MySQL validation output was run or supplied for this review.

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE — Prior reports require correction.** The current shadow service no longer calls `BinanceMinimumExecutionPolicy`; it uses `ReplayMinimumExecutionPolicy`. Also, the FIX-156 status report’s “OPEN” finding state is stale against the later Jean closure record. That closure does not prove technical completion.

## OBJECTIONS

- **AGENT INFERENCE — Do not declare a Replay/Production parity result.** Current configuration-sensitive BUY authority, incomplete price coverage qualification, and absent trace/certificate integration create material false-positive and look-ahead/configuration-drift risk.

- **AGENT INFERENCE — Do not “finish” by adding more call-site checks.** A caller-declared table/operation category cannot prove statement safety. The approved design must first identify the full active Replay data boundary and enforce it structurally.

- **AGENT INFERENCE — The run-ID collision must be corrected before profile seeding.** Otherwise a Replay can proceed with an unrelated historical profile instead of refusing, which is worse than the current fail-closed behavior.

- **AGENT INFERENCE — Jean’s closure is authorization to continue within scope, not evidence that the technical acceptance checks now pass.** This review does not reopen or alter Jean findings.
